reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: First two hours, now three hours – this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines. Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety. The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why. But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process. And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating. Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons – both fake and real – past airport security nearly every time they tried. Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago's O'Hare International. It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become – but the lines are obvious. Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line. Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes. Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this. There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program. PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA. Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes. This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved. The TSA wants to enroll 25 million people in PreCheck. It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks. Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw. Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level. But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways. The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines. It is long past time to make the program work.

questions.stem: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804 is mentioned to____
options: A) explain American's tolerance of current security checks.
B) stress the urgency to strengthen security worldwide.
C) highlight the necessity of upgrading major U.S. airports.
D) emphasize the importance of privacy protection.
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是例证目的题，正确答案 A）explain American's tolerance of current security checks. 定位句在第 2 段：美国人愿意忍受耗时的安检程序以换取更高的安全；埃及航空804号航班坠毁（可能是恐怖分子在地中海上空将其击落）又一次悲剧性地提醒了人们"为什么愿意忍受"。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety. ↔ explain American's tolerance of current security checks.；provides another tragic reminder of why ↔ explain）。其余三项中，B 项属以偏概全：从局部跳到全球、C 项属答非所问：把别处论点贴到此处、D 项属无中生有：杜撰未出现的概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following contributes to long waits at major airports?
options: A) New restrictions on carry-on bags.
B) The declining efficiency of the TSA.
C) An increase in the number of travelers.
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 C）An increase in the number of travelers. 定位句在第 4 段：部分原因是政府未预见到航空出行的陡增，TSA现在正赶着招新的安检员；部分原因是机场可用于安检通道的空间有限；另一个因素可能是更多人为了避免托运行李费而过度打包随身行李——尽管航空公司对此强烈反驳。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel ↔ An increase in the number of travelers.；a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices ↔ An increase in the number of travelers.）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反：把现象反转包装、B 项属无中生有：杜撰未给出的判断、D 项属偷换概念：把原文单次事件改成频繁事件，均可排除。

questions.stem: The word "expedited" (Line 4, Para. 5) is closest in meaning to____
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是词义句意题，正确答案 D）faster. 定位句在第 5 段：通过背景审查的旅客有资格使用"快速安检通道"。这让TSA可以专注于高风险旅客，为所有相关者节省时间。正确项与原文构成同义替换（saving time for everyone involved ↔ faster.；expedited screening lanes ↔ faster.）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有：用一个看似合理的感官词、B 项属偷换概念：从"快"偷换成"便宜"、C 项属无中生有：用通道场景常识做诱饵，均可排除。

questions.stem: One problem with the PreCheck program is____
options: A) a dramatic reduction of its scale.
C) the government's reluctance to back it.
D) an unreasonable price for enrollment.
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是细节题，正确答案 D）an unreasonable price for enrollment. 定位句在第 6 段：它（入选人数）远未接近那个目标，一个大原因是"价签冲击"：旅客每5年必须支付85美元来处理背景审查；从一开始，这个价格就一直是PreCheck的致命缺陷。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks. ↔ an unreasonable price for enrollment.；this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw ↔ an unreasonable price for enrollment.）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反：把扩大目标说成缩小规模、B 项属无中生有：杜撰未出现的判断方向、C 项属与原文相反：把建议性呼吁反转成既成事实，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
options: A) Less Screening for More Safety
C) Getting Stuck in Security Lines
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是主旨题，正确答案 C）Getting Stuck in Security Lines 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（three hours – this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines. ↔ Getting Stuck in Security Lines；most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines ↔ Getting Stuck in Security Lines）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反：用悖论标题制造冲击力、B 项属以偏概全：拿局部对策当全文主旨、D 项属以偏概全：复用末段原词当标题，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: First two hours, now three hours – this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines.
paragraphs.zh: 先是两小时,现在是三小时——这是当局建议人们提前多久到达机场以赶上国内航班,至少在美国一些主要机场是如此,这些机场的安检队伍越来越长。

paragraphs.en: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety. The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why. But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process. And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans' economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.
paragraphs.zh: 美国人愿意忍受耗时的安检程序以换取更高的安全性。埃及航空804号航班的坠毁——恐怖分子可能在地中海上空击落了这架飞机——再次以悲剧的方式提醒我们原因所在。但是,对航空旅客要求过多或提供的安全保障过少会削弱公众对这一过程的支持。而且这是应该的:浪费的时间拖累了美国人的经济和私人生活,更不用说令人恼火了。

paragraphs.en: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons – both fake and real – past airport security nearly every time they tried. Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago's O'Hare International. It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become – but the lines are obvious.
paragraphs.zh: 去年,运输安全管理局(TSA)在一次秘密检查中发现,卧底调查人员几乎每次都能成功将武器——包括假的和真的——偷偷带过机场安检。此后加强的安全措施,加上经济好转和油价走低带来的航空旅行增加,导致芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场等主要机场出现长时间等待。目前尚不清楚机场安检的有效性提高了多少——但排队现象是显而易见的。

paragraphs.en: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line. Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes. Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.
paragraphs.zh: 部分问题在于政府没有预料到航空旅行的急剧增长,因此TSA现在正急于让新的安检人员上岗。部分问题在于机场的安检通道空间有限。另一个因素可能是,更多的人试图在随身行李中塞入过多物品以避免托运行李费用,尽管航空公司对此强烈否认。

paragraphs.en: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program. PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA. Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes. This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved. The TSA wants to enroll 25 million people in PreCheck.
paragraphs.zh: TSA可以采取一项不需要改建机场或匆忙招聘的措施:让更多人加入PreCheck项目。PreCheck本应是旅客和TSA的双赢。通过背景调查的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。这使得TSA能够将重点放在风险较高的旅客身上,为所有相关人员节省时间。TSA希望让2500万人加入PreCheck。

paragraphs.en: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks. Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw. Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level. But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways.
paragraphs.zh: 它远未达到这一目标,一个重要原因是价格过高:乘客必须每五年支付85美元来处理他们的背景调查。从一开始,这个价格标签就是PreCheck的致命缺陷。即将进行的改革可能会将价格降至更合理的水平。但国会应该考虑直接这样做,通过帮助资助PreCheck注册或以其他方式削减成本。

paragraphs.en: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines. It is long past time to make the program work.
paragraphs.zh: TSA不能继续将资源转移到利用率不足的PreCheck通道,而让大多数旅行公众在不必要的队伍中受苦。早就应该让这个项目发挥作用了。

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: "The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers," wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii's last reigning monarch, in 1897. Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society. Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today. Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos. At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens. But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes. Resting in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity. Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new. A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation. Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers. In their eagerness to build bigger telescopes, they forgot that science is not the only way of understanding the world. They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea's fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the island's inhabitants. Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today. Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization. The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens. Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going. Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes. The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea. The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact. To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state. There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.

questions.stem: Queen Liliuokalani's remark in Paragraph 1 indicates____
options: A) her conservative view on the historical role of astronomy.
B) the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society.
C) the regrettable decline of astronomy in ancient times.
D) her appreciation of star watchers' feats in her time.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是细节题，正确答案 B）the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society. 定位句在第 1 段："古代夏威夷人是天文学家，"夏威夷最后一位在位君主 Liliuokalani 女王在 1897 年这样写道。观星者属于夏威夷社会中最受尊崇的成员之列。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society. ↔ the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society.；The ancient Hawaiians ↔ ancient Hawaiian society）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念（时间维度）、D 项属偷换概念（时间+对象），均可排除。

questions.stem: Mauna Kea is deemed as an ideal astronomical site due to____
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是细节题，正确答案 A）its geographical features. 定位句在第 2 段：Mauna Kea 坐落于太平洋之中，其山顶高出地球大部分稠密大气层之上，那里的环境条件使望远镜能够获得无与伦比的清晰图像。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Resting in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere ↔ its geographical features.）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属答非所问、D 项属强加因果（因果颠倒），均可排除。

questions.stem: The construction of the TMT is opposed by some locals partly because____
options: A) it may risk ruining their intellectual life.
B) it reminds them of a humiliating history.
C) their culture will lose a chance of revival.
D) they fear losing control of Mauna Kea.
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是细节题，正确答案 B）it reminds them of a humiliating history. 定位句在第 3 段：一小批但很有声量的夏威夷人与环保人士长期以来都把这些望远镜的存在视为对圣地的不敬，并且是一种令人痛苦的提醒：提醒人们这片土地曾经是一个被吞并的主权国家。正确项与原文构成同义替换（a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation. ↔ it reminds them of a humiliating history.）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that progress in today's astronomy____
options: A) is fulfilling the dreams of ancient Hawaiians.
B) helps spread Hawaiian culture across the world.
C) may uncover the origin of Hawaiian culture.
D) will eventually soften Hawaiians' hostility.
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是推断题，正确答案 A）is fulfilling the dreams of ancient Hawaiians. 定位句在第 5 段：当年驱使早期波利尼西亚人来到夏威夷海岸、想看看地平线外有什么的那同一种好奇心，如今也激励着天文学家去探索星空。正确项与原文构成同义替换（The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens. ↔ is fulfilling the dreams of ancient Hawaiians.；astronomers today to explore the heavens ↔ progress in today's astronomy）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属过度推断、D 项属无中生有（跨段越界），均可排除。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward choosing Mauna Kea as the TMT site is one of____
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是态度题，正确答案 D）full approval. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars. ↔ full approval.；Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality ↔ full approval.）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反（评价对象偷换）、B 项属偷换概念（情感强度）、C 项属偷换概念（情感强度），均可排除。

paragraphs.en: "The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers," wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii's last reigning monarch, in 1897. Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society. Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today. Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
paragraphs.zh: 1897年，夏威夷最后一位在位君主利留卡拉尼女王写道："古代夏威夷人是天文学家。"观星者是夏威夷社会中最受尊敬的成员之一。遗憾的是，如今夏威夷的天文学并非一切安好。围绕三十米望远镜(TMT)的建设爆发了抗议活动,这是一座巨型天文台,有望彻底改变人类对宇宙的认识。

paragraphs.en: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens. But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes. Resting in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
paragraphs.zh: 争议的焦点是TMT计划建设在莫纳克亚山的选址,这是一座休眠火山,被一些夏威夷人奉为piko,连接着夏威夷群岛与天堂。但莫纳克亚山也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的所在地。莫纳克亚山位于太平洋中,其峰顶高出地球大部分稠密大气层,那里的条件使望远镜能够获得无与伦比清晰度的图像。

paragraphs.en: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new. A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
paragraphs.zh: 反对在莫纳克亚山上建造望远镜并非新鲜事。一小部分但声音响亮的夏威夷人和环保主义者长期以来一直将望远镜的存在视为对神圣土地的不敬,以及对曾经是主权国家被占领的痛苦回忆。

paragraphs.en: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers. In their eagerness to build bigger telescopes, they forgot that science is not the only way of understanding the world. They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea's fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the island's inhabitants. Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today.
paragraphs.zh: 当前争议的部分责任在于天文学家。在急于建造更大望远镜的过程中,他们忘记了科学并非理解世界的唯一方式。他们并不总是优先保护莫纳克亚山脆弱的生态系统或其对岛屿居民的神圣性。夏威夷文化不是过去的遗迹,它是一种正在经历复兴的鲜活文化。

paragraphs.en: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization. The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens. Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going. Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而,科学也有其文化历史,其根源可以追溯到文明的黎明。最初将早期波利尼西亚人带到夏威夷海岸的那种探寻地平线之外的好奇心,如今也激励着天文学家探索天空。呼吁拆除莫纳克亚山上的所有望远镜或禁止未来在那里开发的主张忽视了这样一个现实:天文学和夏威夷文化都在寻求回答关于我们是谁、我们从哪里来以及我们将去往何处的重大问题。也许这就是为什么我们探索星空,仿佛在回应一种认识我们自己和我们真正祖先家园的原始召唤。

paragraphs.en: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea. The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact. To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state. There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.
paragraphs.zh: 天文学界正在做出妥协以改变其对莫纳克亚山的使用。TMT选址是为了最大限度地减少望远镜在岛屿周围的可见度,并避免考古和环境影响。为了限制莫纳克亚山上望远镜的数量,旧望远镜将在其使用寿命结束时被移除,其所在地将恢复为自然状态。没有理由不能欢迎每个人来到莫纳克亚山拥抱他们的文化遗产并研究星空。

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile." With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to. The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century. Many argue that it is a flawed concept. It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do. By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures. If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects? A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question. Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens. Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing. While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes. Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline. Yet this isn't the case with all countries. Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment. This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different. So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough. It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes – all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being. The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth. But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.

questions.stem: Robert F. Kennedy is cited because he____
options: A) praised the UK for its GDP.
C) misinterpreted the role of GDP.
D) had a low opinion of GDP.
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是推断题，正确答案 D）had a low opinion of GDP. 定位句在第 1 段：罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾说,一国的 GDP 衡量了 "除了那些让生活值得过的东西以外的一切"。正确项与原文构成同义替换（everything except that which makes life worthwhile ↔ had a low opinion of GDP）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from Paragraph 2 that____
options: A) the UK is reluctant to remold its economic pattern.
B) GDP as the measure of success is widely defied in the UK.
C) the UK will contribute less to the world economy.
D) policymakers in the UK are paying less attention to GDP.
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是推断题，正确答案 B）GDP as the measure of success is widely defied in the UK. 定位句在第 2 段：许多人认为 GDP 是有缺陷的概念,它度量了不重要的东西、却漏掉了重要的东西。按最新数据,英国的 GDP 一直是西方世界羡慕的对象——失业率创新低、增速亮眼。但若一切如此美好,为什么会有超过 1700 万人不顾对国家经济前景的警告而投票脱欧?正确项与原文构成同义替换（If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects? ↔ GDP as the measure of success is widely defied in the UK）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the recent annual study?
options: A) It is sponsored by 163 countries.
B) It excludes GDP as an indicator.
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是细节题，正确答案 D）Its results are enlightening. 定位句在第 3 段：一项最近的年度研究——考察各国把增长转化为福祉的能力——为上述问题带来一些启示。在所测的 163 国中,英国在确保经济增长转化为有意义的公民福祉方面表现垫底之一。该研究不是只盯 GDP,而是从健康、教育、公民社会参与等 40 多项指标入手,以得出更全面的评估。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens ↔ Its results are enlightening；sheds some light on that question ↔ Its results are enlightening）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: In the last two paragraphs, the author suggests that____
options: A) the UK is preparing for an economic boom.
B) high GDP foreshadows an economic decline.
C) it is essential to consider factors beyond GDP.
D) it requires caution to handle economic issues.
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是推断题，正确答案 C）it is essential to consider factors beyond GDP. 定位句在第 6 段：所以 Kennedy 当年所指的是:GDP 虽是衡量国家经济活动最常用的方法,但作为度量手段已经不够用了。它没有涵盖环境质量、教育成果这些重要因素——而这些正是构成个人幸福感的来源。全球与英国预期的经济急挫可能让我们赖以生存的日常服务下滑;但若决策者把重心转到提升福祉而非只盯 GDP 数字,反倒可能避开预测中的灾难,甚至看到进步。正确项与原文构成同义替换（as a measure, it is no longer enough. It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes ↔ it is essential to consider factors beyond GDP；policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom ↔ it is essential to consider factors beyond GDP）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属强加因果、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best title for the text?
options: A) High GDP But Inadequate Well-being, a UK Lesson
B) GDP Figures, a Window on Global Economic Health
C) Robert F. Kennedy, a Terminator of GDP
D) Brexit, the UK's Gateway to Well-being
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是主旨题，正确答案 A）High GDP But Inadequate Well-being, a UK Lesson 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens ↔ High GDP But Inadequate Well-being, a UK Lesson；This is a lesson that rich countries can learn ↔ a UK Lesson）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属过度推断、D 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile." With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
paragraphs.zh: Robert F. Kennedy曾说过，一个国家的GDP衡量的是"除了使生活有价值的东西之外的一切"。随着英国投票决定离开欧盟，而GDP已被预测将因此放缓，现在正是评估他所指内容的时机。

paragraphs.en: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century. Many argue that it is a flawed concept. It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do. By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures. If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects?
paragraphs.zh: GDP及其有用性的问题已经困扰政策制定者半个多世纪。许多人认为它是一个有缺陷的概念。它衡量无关紧要的东西，却遗漏了重要的东西。根据最近的大多数衡量标准，英国的GDP一直是西方世界令人羡慕的，失业率创纪录地低，增长数字很高。如果一切进展如此顺利，那么为什么有超过1700万人投票支持Brexit，尽管有人警告这可能对他们国家的经济前景造成什么影响?

paragraphs.en: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question. Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens. Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
paragraphs.zh: 最近一项关于各国及其将增长转化为福祉能力的年度研究为这个问题提供了一些启示。在被衡量的163个国家中，英国在确保经济增长转化为对其公民有意义的改善方面表现最差。除了仅仅关注GDP之外，还衡量了来自健康、教育和公民社会参与的40多套不同标准，以便对各国的表现进行更全面的评估。

paragraphs.en: While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes. Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline. Yet this isn't the case with all countries. Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然所有这些国家都面临着各自的挑战，但存在一些一致的主题。是的，自2008年全球崩溃以来，经济出现了初步复苏，但在健康和教育等领域的关键指标上，主要经济体持续下滑。然而，并非所有国家都是这种情况。一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的衡量标准上都取得了巨大进步。

paragraphs.en: This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different.
paragraphs.zh: 这是富裕国家可以学习的一课：当GDP不再被视为衡量一个国家成功的唯一标准时，世界看起来会非常不同。

paragraphs.en: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough. It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes – all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，Kennedy所指的是，虽然GDP一直是衡量国家经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不再足够。它不包括诸如环境质量或教育成果等重要因素——所有这些都有助于一个人的幸福感。

paragraphs.en: The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth. But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
paragraphs.zh: 世界各地和英国预测的增长急剧下滑可能导致我们的福祉和增长所依赖的日常服务下降。但是，将努力重新集中在改善福祉而不是仅仅担心GDP数字上的政策制定者可以避免预测的厄运，甚至可能看到进步。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: In a rare unanimous ruling, the US Supreme Court has overturned the corruption conviction of a former Virginia governor, Robert McDonnell. But it did so while holding its nose at the ethics of his conduct, which included accepting gifts such as a Rolex watch and a Ferrari automobile from a company seeking access to government. The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties. Merely helping a gift-giver gain access to other officials, unless done with clear intent to pressure those officials, is not corruption, the justices found. The court did suggest that accepting favors in return for opening doors is "distasteful" and "nasty." But under anti-bribery laws, proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation. Simply arranging a meeting, making a phone call, or hosting an event is not an "official act". The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal. Elected leaders must be allowed to help supporters deal with bureaucratic problems without fear of prosecution for bribery. "The basic compact underlying representative government," wrote Chief Justice John Roberts for the court, "assumes that public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns." But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government. Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings simply because an individual or group provides a campaign donation or a personal gift. This type of integrity requires well-enforced laws in government transparency, such as records of official meetings, rules on lobbying, and information about each elected leader's source of wealth. Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption. But it is not always corruption. Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy. If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society – that all are equal in treatment by government – is undermined. Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual. The court's ruling is a step forward in the struggle against both corruption and official favoritism.

questions.stem: The underlined sentence (Para. 1) most probably shows that the court____
options: A) avoided defining the extent of McDonnell's duties.
B) made no compromise in convicting McDonnell.
C) was contemptuous of McDonnell's conduct.
D) refused to comment on McDonnell's ethics.
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是词义句意题，正确答案 C）was contemptuous of McDonnell's conduct. 定位句在第 1 段：但法院如此判决时，是 "捏着鼻子" 看待他行为中的道德问题的——这些行为包括接受一家寻求接近政府的公司所赠的劳力士手表与法拉利轿车等礼物。正确项与原文构成同义替换（holding its nose at the ethics of his conduct ↔ was contemptuous of McDonnell's conduct）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 4, an official act is deemed corruptive only if it involves____
options: B) sizable gains in the form of gifts.
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是细节题，正确答案 C）concrete returns for gift-givers. 定位句在第 4 段：但依据反贿赂法，必须证明存在具体的好处，例如批准某项合同或法规。正确项与原文构成同义替换（proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation ↔ concrete returns for gift-givers）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The court's ruling is based on the assumption that public officials are____
options: A) justified in addressing the needs of their constituents.
B) qualified to deal independently with bureaucratic issues.
C) allowed to focus on the concerns of their supporters.
D) exempt from conviction on the charge of favoritism.
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是推断题，正确答案 A）justified in addressing the needs of their constituents. 定位句在第 5 段：首席大法官 John Roberts 代表法院写道："代议制政府所依据的基本契约假定，公职人员应当倾听选民的诉求并就其关切采取行动。"正确项与原文构成同义替换（public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns ↔ justified in addressing the needs of their constituents；their constituents ↔ their constituents）。其余三项中，B 项属过度推断、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: Well-enforced laws in government transparency are needed to____
options: A) awaken the conscience of officials.
B) guarantee fair play in official access.
C) allow for certain kinds of lobbying.
D) inspire hopes in average people.
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是细节题，正确答案 B）guarantee fair play in official access. 定位句在第 6 段：但这一判决强化了一种需要——由公民及其民选代表（而非法院）来确保接触政府的机会平等。官员决不能仅因为某个人或团体提供了竞选捐款或私人礼物，就在提供信息或安排会面上偏袒他们。这种正直要求在政府透明上拥有执行有力的法律，例如官方会议的记录、关于游说的规则，以及关于每位民选领导人财富来源的信息。正确项与原文构成同义替换（to ensure equality of access to government ↔ guarantee fair play in official access；Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings ↔ fair play in official access）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the court's ruling is____
questions.explanation: 第 40 题是态度题，正确答案 D）supportive. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（The court's ruling is a step forward in the struggle against both corruption and official favoritism ↔ supportive；The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal ↔ supportive）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: In a rare unanimous ruling, the US Supreme Court has overturned the corruption conviction of a former Virginia governor, Robert McDonnell. But it did so while holding its nose at the ethics of his conduct, which included accepting gifts such as a Rolex watch and a Ferrari automobile from a company seeking access to government.
paragraphs.zh: 在一项罕见的一致裁决中,美国最高法院推翻了前弗吉尼亚州州长罗伯特·麦克唐纳的腐败定罪。但最高法院在作出裁决时对其行为的道德操守表示不齿,这些行为包括接受一家寻求接触政府的公司赠送的劳力士手表和法拉利汽车等礼物。

paragraphs.en: The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
paragraphs.zh: 最高法院的裁决称,麦克唐纳案审判中的法官未能告知陪审团,必须仅审视他的"官方行为",即这位前州长就与其职责相关的"具体"和"未决"问题所作的决定。

paragraphs.en: Merely helping a gift-giver gain access to other officials, unless done with clear intent to pressure those officials, is not corruption, the justices found.
paragraphs.zh: 大法官们认为,仅仅帮助送礼者接触其他官员,除非是带有明确意图向这些官员施压,否则不构成腐败。

paragraphs.en: The court did suggest that accepting favors in return for opening doors is "distasteful" and "nasty." But under anti-bribery laws, proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation. Simply arranging a meeting, making a phone call, or hosting an event is not an "official act".
paragraphs.zh: 最高法院确实表示,接受好处以换取打开方便之门是"令人反感的"和"恶劣的"。但根据反贿赂法,必须证明存在具体利益,如批准合同或法规。仅仅安排会面、打电话或举办活动并不是"官方行为"。

paragraphs.en: The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal. Elected leaders must be allowed to help supporters deal with bureaucratic problems without fear of prosecution for bribery. "The basic compact underlying representative government," wrote Chief Justice John Roberts for the court, "assumes that public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns."
paragraphs.zh: 最高法院的裁决在界定一种不构成犯罪的偏袒行为方面在法律上是合理的。必须允许民选领导人帮助支持者处理官僚问题,而无需担心因贿赂而受到起诉。首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨代表法院写道:"代议制政府所依据的基本契约假定,公职人员将倾听选民的意见并根据他们的关切采取行动。"

paragraphs.en: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government. Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings simply because an individual or group provides a campaign donation or a personal gift. This type of integrity requires well-enforced laws in government transparency, such as records of official meetings, rules on lobbying, and information about each elected leader's source of wealth.
paragraphs.zh: 但这一裁决强化了一种需求,即由公民及其民选代表而非法院来确保政府接触渠道的平等。不得允许官员仅仅因为某个个人或团体提供了竞选捐款或个人礼物,就在提供信息或安排会面时偏袒他们。这种廉洁操守需要政府透明度方面执行良好的法律,例如官方会面记录、游说规则以及每位民选领导人财富来源的信息。

paragraphs.en: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption. But it is not always corruption. Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy. If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society – that all are equal in treatment by government – is undermined. Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
paragraphs.zh: 官方接触渠道中的偏袒可能会助长公众对腐败的看法。但它并不总是腐败。相反,官员必须避免双重标准,或对普通民众和富人采取不同类型的接触方式。如果可以收买关系,民主社会的一个基本前提——即所有人在政府对待下一律平等——就会被削弱。良好治理建立在理解每个人固有价值的基础之上。

paragraphs.en: The court's ruling is a step forward in the struggle against both corruption and official favoritism.
paragraphs.zh: 最高法院的裁决是反腐败和反官方偏袒斗争中向前迈出的一步。

blanks.explanation: 第 1 空正确答案 B）Besides。前后两句都是拥抱的好处、并列叠加。其余三项：A）Unlike 语义相反，表对比、C）Despite 表让步转折，方向不符、D）Throughout 表时空贯穿，搭配不通，均可排除。

第 5 空正确答案 B）involving。研究涉及400名成年人。其余三项：A）collecting 义为收集，对象不对、C）guiding 义为引导，逻辑不符、D）affecting 义为影响，宾语错位，均可排除。
第 6 空正确答案 D）on。effect on＝对……的影响。其余三项：A）of of 已用于前半、B）in in 不与 effect 搭配、C）at at 不与 effect 搭配，均可排除。
第 7 空正确答案 B）exposed。感染前先接触病毒。其余三项：A）devoted be devoted to＝致力于、C）lost be lost to＝丧失给、D）attracted be attracted to＝被吸引，均可排除。
第 8 空正确答案 C）down。come down with＝患（病）。其余三项：A）across come across＝偶遇、B）along come along＝出现/进展、D）out come out＝出来/出版，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 A）calculated。得出32%这一量化结论。其余三项：B）denied 义为否认，与正面结论反、C）doubted 义为怀疑，态度不符、D）imagined 义为想象，非科学得出，均可排除。
第 10 空正确答案 D）explained。减压效应解释了32%的益处。其余三项：A）served 义为服务，搭配不当、B）required 义为需要，逻辑错位、C）restored 义为恢复，文意不符，均可排除。
第 11 空正确答案 A）Even。进一步说连得病的人也获益。其余三项：B）Still 义为仍然，转折偏弱、C）Rather 义为而是，表纠正、D）Thus 义为因此，因果不成立，均可排除。
第 12 空正确答案 B）symptoms。已感冒者病情更轻＝症状更轻。其余三项：A）defeats 义为失败，与病无关、C）tests 义为测试，文意不符、D）errors 义为错误，与病无关，均可排除。
第 13 空正确答案 D）increased。压力本会增大患感冒风险。其余三项：A）minimized 义为最小化，方向相反、B）highlighted 义为强调，非真增大、C）controlled 义为受控，方向不符，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 B）associated。风险与压力相关联。其余三项：A）equipped be equipped with＝配备、C）presented present with＝向……呈递、D）compared compared with＝与……相比，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 C）generate。拥抱产生被支持的感受。其余三项：A）assess 义为评估，非产生、B）moderate 义为缓和、减弱、D）record 义为记录，文意不符，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 A）in the face of。面对困难时有人相助。其余三项：B）in the form of 义为以……形式、C）in the way of 义为妨碍/在……方面、D）in the name of 义为以……名义，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 C）attribute。把益处归因于催产素释放。其余三项：A）transfer transfer A to B＝转移、B）commit commit to＝致力/犯下、D）return return A to B＝归还，均可排除。
第 18 空正确答案 A）because。之所以叫结合激素，因它促进依恋。其余三项：B）unless 义为除非，条件不符、C）though 义为尽管，让步反向、D）until 义为直到，时间不符，均可排除。
第 19 空正确答案 C）remains。与『释放入血』相对，部分留在脑中。其余三项：A）emerges 义为出现，与对比不符、B）vanishes 义为消失，与下文矛盾、D）decreases 义为减少，文意不符，均可排除。
第 20 空正确答案 D）influences。催产素在脑中作用于情绪等。其余三项：A）experiences 义为经历，主体错位、B）combines 义为结合，搭配不当、C）justifies 义为证明……正当，均可排除。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: Every Saturday morning, at 9 am, more than 50,000 runners set off to run 5km around their local park. The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad. Events are free, staffed by thousands of volunteers. Runners range from four years old to grandparents; their times range from Andrew Baddeley's world record 13 minutes 48 seconds up to an hour. Parkrun is succeeding where London's Olympic "legacy" is failing. Ten years ago on Monday, it was announced that the Games of the 30th Olympiad would be in London. Planning documents pledged that the great legacy of the Games would be to lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches. The population would be fitter, healthier and produce more winners. It has not happened. The number of adults doing weekly sport did rise, by nearly 2 million in the run-up to 2012 – but the general population was growing faster. Worse, the numbers are now falling at an accelerating rate. The opposition claims primary school pupils doing at least two hours of sport a week have nearly halved. Obesity has risen among adults and children. Official retrospections continue as to why London 2012 failed to "inspire a generation." The success of Parkrun offers answers. Parkun is not a race but a time trial: Your only competitor is the clock. The ethos welcomes anybody. There is as much joy over a puffed-out first-timer being clapped over the line as there is about top talent shining. The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to get more people doing sport and to produce more elite athletes. The dual aim was mixed up: The stress on success over taking part was intimidating for newcomers. Indeed, there is something a little absurd in the state getting involved in the planning of such a fundamentally "grassroots" concept as community sports associations. If there is a role for government, it should really be getting involved in providing common goods – making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts, and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools. But successive governments have presided over selling green spaces, squeezing money from local authorities and declining attention on sport in education. Instead of wordy, worthy strategies, future governments need to do more to provide the conditions for sport to thrive. Or at least not make them worse.

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, Parkrun has____.
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 A）gained great popularity 定位句在第 1 段：每周六上午 9 点，超过 5 万名跑者在当地公园开跑 5 公里。Parkrun 这一现象始于十几个朋友，如今已在英国催生 400 场活动，海外更多。正确项与原文构成同义替换（more than 50,000 runners set off to run 5km around their local park ↔ gained great popularity；has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad ↔ gained great popularity）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author believes that London's Olympic "legacy" has failed to____.
options: D) increase sport hours in schools
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 B）promote sport participation 定位句在第 2 段：Parkrun 在伦敦奥运"遗产"失败之处取得了成功。十年前的那个周一，第 30 届奥运会落地伦敦的消息正式公布。规划文件承诺，奥运会的伟大遗产是把一国国民从沙发上撬起，让他们成为运动爱好者。人口本该变得更健康、更善运动、产生更多冠军。这并没有发生。正确项与原文构成同义替换（lever a nation of sport lovers away from their couches ↔ promote sport participation；It has not happened ↔ failed to）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

questions.stem: Parkrun is different from Olympic games in that it____.
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是细节题，正确答案 C）does not emphasize elitism 定位句在第 3 段：Parkrun 不是赛跑而是计时赛：你唯一的对手是钟表。它的精神欢迎所有人。气喘吁吁的新手被掌声送过终点线时的喜悦，与顶尖选手发光时的喜悦同等多。相比之下，奥运推动者想让更多人参与运动，又要生产更多精英运动员。这双重目标混淆了：对成功而非参与的强调，把新人吓退了。正确项与原文构成同义替换（The ethos welcomes anybody ↔ does not emphasize elitism；The Olympic bidders, by contrast, wanted to ... produce more elite athletes ↔ does not emphasize elitism）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: With regard to mass sports, the author holds that governments should____.
options: C) increase funds for sports clubs
D) invest in public sports facilities
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是细节题，正确答案 D）invest in public sports facilities 定位句在第 4 段：如果政府要扮演角色，那它真正该做的是介入提供公共物品——确保有场地建运动场，有资金铺设网球场和无挡板篮球场，并鼓励学校开展所有这些活动。正确项与原文构成同义替换（providing common goods ↔ invest in public sports facilities；making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts ↔ invest in public sports facilities）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author's attitude to what UK governments have done for sports is____.
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是态度题，正确答案 B）critical 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（But successive governments have presided over selling green spaces, squeezing money from local authorities and declining attention on sport in education ↔ critical；Or at least not make them worse ↔ critical）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: With so much focus on children's use of screens, it's easy for parents to forget about their own screen use. "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement. It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine." Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise. She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children. During a separate observation, she saw that phones became a source of tension in the family. Parents would be looking at their emails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention. Infants are wired to look at parents' faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive – as they often are when absorbed in a device – it can be extremely disconcerting for the children. Radesky cites the "still face experiment" devised by developmental psychologist Ed Tronick in the 1970s. In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention. "Parents don't have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need," says Radesky. On the other hand, Tronick himself is concerned that the worries about kids' use of screens are born out of an "oppressive ideology that demands that parents should always be interacting" with their children: "It's based on a somewhat fantasised, very white, very upper-middle-class ideology that says if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them." Tronick believes that just because a child isn't learning from the screen doesn't mean there's no value to it – particularly if it gives parents time to have a shower, do housework or simply have a break from their child. Parents, he says, can get a lot out of using their devices to speak to a friend or get some work out of the way. This can make them feel happier, which lets them be more available to their child the rest of the time.

questions.stem: According to Jenny Radesky, digital products are designed to____.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是细节题，正确答案 B）absorb user attention 定位句在第 1 段：Jenny Radesky 在其数字游戏研究中说：科技被设计得真的会把你吸进去，数字产品的存在就是为了促进最大化的用户投入。正确项与原文构成同义替换（suck you in ↔ absorb user attention；promote maximal engagement ↔ absorb user attention）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Radesky's food-testing exercise shows that mothers' use of devices____.
options: C) slows down babies' verbal development
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是细节题，正确答案 D）reduces mother-child communication 定位句在第 2 段：她发现实验中使用设备的母亲与孩子发起的言语互动减少了 20%、非言语互动减少了 39%。正确项与原文构成同义替换（fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children ↔ reduces mother-child communication）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: Radesky cites the "still face experiment" to show that____.
options: A) it is easy for children to get used to blank expressions
B) verbal expressions are unnecessary for emotional exchange
C) children are insensitive to changes in their parents' mood
D) parents need to respond to children's emotional needs
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是例证目的题，正确答案 D）parents need to respond to children's emotional needs 定位句在第 3 段：Radesky 说：父母不必时时刻刻精致地陪伴，但需要有平衡，父母需要对孩子言语或非言语的情感需求保持回应与敏感。正确项与原文构成同义替换（parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need ↔ parents need to respond to children's emotional needs）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The oppressive ideology mentioned by Tronick requires parents to____.
options: A) protect kids from exposure to wild fantasies
B) teach their kids at least 30,000 words a year
C) ensure constant interaction with their children
D) remain concerned about kids' use of screens
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是细节题，正确答案 C）ensure constant interaction with their children 定位句在第 4 段：另一方面，Tronick 本人担心，对孩子使用屏幕的种种担忧源自一种压迫性的意识形态，这种意识形态要求父母必须始终与孩子互动。正确项与原文构成同义替换（parents should always be interacting ↔ ensure constant interaction with their children）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Tronick, kids' use of screens may____.
options: A) give their parents some free time
B) make their parents more creative
C) help them with their homework
D) help them become more attentive
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是细节题，正确答案 A）give their parents some free time 定位句在第 4 段：Tronick 认为，孩子没有从屏幕里学到东西并不意味着屏幕没有价值——尤其当它给父母腾出时间洗澡、做家务或干脆从孩子身边喘口气时。正确项与原文构成同义替换（gives parents time to have a shower, do housework or simply have a break from their child ↔ give their parents some free time）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属答非所问、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: With so much focus on children's use of screens, it's easy for parents to forget about their own screen use. "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement. It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine."
paragraphs.zh: 由于过多关注儿童使用屏幕的问题,家长很容易忘记自己对屏幕的使用。Jenny Radesky在她关于数字化游戏的研究中说:"科技的设计就是要真正吸引你,数字产品的存在是为了促进最大程度的参与。这使人难以脱离,并导致大量渗透到家庭日常生活中。"

paragraphs.en: Radesky has studied the use of mobile phones and tablets at mealtimes by giving mother-child pairs a food-testing exercise. She found that mothers who used devices during the exercise started 20 per cent fewer verbal and 39 per cent fewer nonverbal interactions with their children. During a separate observation, she saw that phones became a source of tension in the family. Parents would be looking at their emails while the children would be making excited bids for their attention.
paragraphs.zh: Radesky研究了用餐时使用手机和平板电脑的情况,她让母子配对进行食物测试练习。她发现,在练习过程中使用设备的母亲与孩子进行的语言互动减少了百分之二十,非语言互动减少了百分之三十九。在另一次观察中,她看到手机成为家庭中紧张关系的来源。父母会查看电子邮件,而孩子们则会兴奋地争取他们的注意力。

paragraphs.en: Infants are wired to look at parents' faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive – as they often are when absorbed in a device – it can be extremely disconcerting for the children. Radesky cites the "still face experiment" devised by developmental psychologist Ed Tronick in the 1970s. In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention. "Parents don't have to be exquisitely present at all times, but there needs to be a balance and parents need to be responsive and sensitive to a child's verbal or nonverbal expressions of an emotional need," says Radesky.
paragraphs.zh: 婴儿天生会看着父母的脸来试图理解他们的世界,如果这些脸是空白和无反应的——就像沉浸在设备中时经常出现的那样——这对孩子来说可能会非常令人不安。Radesky引用了发展心理学家Ed Tronick在二十世纪七十年代设计的"静止面孔实验"。在实验中,要求一位母亲先以正常方式与孩子互动,然后面无表情,不给孩子任何视觉社交反馈:随着孩子试图吸引母亲的注意力,她变得越来越焦虑。Radesky说:"父母不必时刻都极度专注,但需要有一个平衡,父母需要对孩子的语言或非语言情感需求表达做出回应和敏感。"

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, Tronick himself is concerned that the worries about kids' use of screens are born out of an "oppressive ideology that demands that parents should always be interacting" with their children: "It's based on a somewhat fantasised, very white, very upper-middle-class ideology that says if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them." Tronick believes that just because a child isn't learning from the screen doesn't mean there's no value to it – particularly if it gives parents time to have a shower, do housework or simply have a break from their child. Parents, he says, can get a lot out of using their devices to speak to a friend or get some work out of the way. This can make them feel happier, which lets them be more available to their child the rest of the time.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面,Tronick本人担心对孩子使用屏幕的忧虑源于一种"压迫性的意识形态,要求父母应该始终与孩子互动":"这基于一种有些理想化的、非常白人的、非常中上阶层的意识形态,认为如果你没有让孩子接触三万个单词,你就是在忽视他们。"Tronick认为,仅仅因为孩子没有从屏幕中学习并不意味着它没有价值——特别是如果它能让父母有时间洗澡、做家务或只是从孩子那里休息一下。他说,父母可以通过使用设备与朋友交谈或完成一些工作而获得很多好处。这可以让他们感到更快乐,从而让他们在其余时间更能陪伴孩子。

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year. After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn't it? And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic. But while this may be true, it's not a good enough reason to condemn gap years. There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career. But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits – in fact, it probably enhances it. Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not. Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes – all things that first-year students often struggle with the most. Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders. If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices. According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once. This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college. Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes. It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game. At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department. Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.

questions.stem: One of the reasons for high-school graduates not taking a gap year is that____.
options: A) they think it academically misleading
B) they have a lot of fun to expect in college
C) it feels strange to do differently from others
D) it seems worthless to take off-campus courses
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是细节题，正确答案 C）it feels strange to do differently from others 定位句在第 1 段：毕竟，要是你认识的所有人秋天都要去上大学，单单自己留一年看上去就很傻，不是吗？而且上了 12 年学之后，再花一年时间去做非学业的事，本就不太自然。正确项与原文构成同义替换（if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year ↔ it feels strange to do differently from others）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: Studies from the US and Australia imply that taking a gap year helps____.
options: A) keep students from being unrealistic
B) lower risks in choosing careers
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是推断题，正确答案 D）relieve freshmen of pressures 定位句在第 3 段：美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，相比不休 gap year 的学生，休过 gap year 的学生进大学时通常准备得更充分、表现也更好。gap year 非但不会让学生落后，反而推他们一把——让他们提前准备好独立、新责任和环境变化，而这些恰恰是大一新生最易吃力的方面。正确项与原文构成同义替换（all things that first-year students often struggle with the most ↔ relieve freshmen of pressures）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属过度推断、C 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: The word "acclimation" (Para. 3) is closest in meaning to____.
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是词义句意题，正确答案 A）adaptation 定位句在第 3 段：gap year 的经历能在适应大学、被抛进全新环境时减轻冲击，让学生更容易把心思放在学业和活动上，而非花在适应不良的失误上。正确项与原文构成同义替换（adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment ↔ adaptation）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: A gap year may save money for students by helping them____.
options: D) decide on the right major
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是细节题，正确答案 D）decide on the right major 定位句在第 4 段：许多学生申请大学时填一个专业，上了课之后又换另一个。这本身不一定是坏事，但要看学校，换得太晚要补学分，可能很费钱。例如在波士顿学院，要从别的院系转去护理学院得多读一年。一开始就用 gap year 把事情想清楚，能减少日后压力、省下日后的开销。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on ↔ decide on the right major）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属过度推断、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The most suitable title for this text would be____.
options: A) In Favor of the Gap Year
B) The ABCs of the Gap Year
C) The Gap Year Comes Back
D) The Gap Year: A Dilemma
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是主旨题，正确答案 A）In Favor of the Gap Year 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits – in fact, it probably enhances it ↔ In Favor of the Gap Year；Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not ↔ In Favor of the Gap Year；Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on ↔ In Favor of the Gap Year）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year. After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn't it? And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，普遍存在的立即上大学的社会压力，加上快速发展的世界中日益增高的期望，常常导致学生完全忽视间隔年的可能性。毕竟，如果你认识的每个人都在秋季上大学，那么推迟一年似乎很愚蠢，不是吗？而且在上了12年学之后，花一年时间做一些非学术性的事情感觉并不自然。

paragraphs.en: But while this may be true, it's not a good enough reason to condemn gap years. There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career. But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits – in fact, it probably enhances it.
paragraphs.zh: 但尽管这可能是事实，却不足以成为谴责间隔年的充分理由。人们总是不断担心在社会延续的"冲向终点线的竞赛"中落后于其他所有人，无论那是通向研究生院、医学院还是一份高薪职业。但尽管存在普遍的误解，间隔年并不会阻碍学业追求的成功——事实上，它可能会增强成功。

paragraphs.en: Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not. Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes – all things that first-year students often struggle with the most. Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
paragraphs.zh: 来自美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，经历间隔年的学生通常比没有经历间隔年的学生为大学做了更好的准备，并且在大学中表现更好。间隔年不是把学生拉回来，而是通过让他们为独立、新责任和环境变化做好准备来推动他们前进——这些都是大一新生往往最难应对的事情。间隔年经历可以减轻适应大学和被投入全新环境时的冲击，使人更容易专注于学业和活动，而不是适应过程中的失误。

paragraphs.en: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices. According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once. This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college. Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes. It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game. At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department. Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你不相信用一年时间探索兴趣的内在价值，那么请考虑它对未来学业选择的财务影响。根据美国国家教育统计中心的数据，近80%的大学生最终至少换过一次专业。这并不令人惊讶，因为高中基础必修课程使学生对大学中等待他们的广阔学术可能性了解甚少。许多学生发现自己在大学申请中列出一个专业，但在上了大学课程后换到另一个专业。这不一定是坏事，但取决于学校，如果换专业太晚，补学分可能代价高昂。例如在Boston College，如果你从其他院系转到护理学院，就必须额外完成一年学业。最初花一年间隔年来弄清楚这些事情，可以帮助防止压力并在以后节省金钱。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management. In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires – nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago. In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work – such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep – that affect the lives of all Americans. Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts. As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire? "It's already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country," he says. "We need to take a magnifying glass to that. Like, 'Wait a minute, is this OK?' Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?" Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say. For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive. Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change – how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires. While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation. "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says. Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be. Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited." At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado. But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says. "We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire," Balch says. "It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today."

questions.stem: More frequent wildfires have become a national concern because in 2015 they____.
options: B) consumed a record-high percentage of budget
C) severely damaged the ecology of western states
D) caused a huge rise of infrastructure expenditure
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 B）consumed a record-high percentage of budget 定位句在第 2 段：2015年，美国林务局有史以来首次把其55亿美元年度预算的过半用于救火——几乎是它20年前同类支出占比的两倍。正确项与原文构成同义替换（for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget ↔ consumed a record-high percentage of budget）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Moritz calls for the use of "a magnifying glass" to____.
options: A) raise more funds for fire-prone areas
B) avoid the redirection of federal money
C) find wildfire-free parts of the landscape
D) guarantee safer spending of public funds
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是细节题，正确答案 D）guarantee safer spending of public funds 定位句在第 4 段：我们得拿放大镜审视这件事。就好像"等等，这样真的OK吗？"——我们是不是该把那些钱转去用在风险更低的地段？正确项与原文构成同义替换（redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape ↔ guarantee safer spending of public funds；Wait a minute, is this OK? ↔ guarantee safer spending of public funds）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属范围程度偷改，均可排除。

questions.stem: While admitting that climate is a key element, Moritz notes that____.
options: A) public debates have not settled yet
C) other factors should not be overlooked
D) a shift in the view of fire has taken place
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是细节题，正确答案 C）other factors should not be overlooked 定位句在第 7 段：Moritz说，虽然气候是一个关键因素，但它不应以牺牲方程式其余部分为代价。正确项与原文构成同义替换（it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation ↔ other factors should not be overlooked）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属答非所问、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The overly simplified view Moritz mentions is a result of failing to____.
options: A) discover the fundamental makeup of nature
B) explore the mechanism of the human systems
C) maximize the role of landscape in human life
D) understand the interrelations of man and nature
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是细节题，正确答案 D）understand the interrelations of man and nature 定位句在第 8 段：他说，人类系统与我们栖居的景观是相互关联的，相互作用是双向的。他指出，没认清这一点，就会导致"对解决方案视野的过度简化"。正确项与原文构成同义替换（The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked ↔ understand the interrelations of man and nature；Failing to recognize that ↔ failing to ... understand）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属以偏概全、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Professor Balch points out that fire is something man should____.
questions.explanation: 第 40 题是细节题，正确答案 B）come to terms with 定位句在第 9 段：但她说，承认火在人类生活中不可避免的存在，是制定使其尽可能安全的法律、政策与实践所必须的一种态度。正确项与原文构成同义替换（acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life ↔ come to terms with；We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire ↔ come to terms with）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.
paragraphs.zh: 火灾生态学与管理专家Max Moritz教授表示,尽管野火发生频率的增加常被视为西部各州的问题,但由于其对联邦税收的影响,这是一个全国性的关切。

paragraphs.en: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires – nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago. In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work – such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep – that affect the lives of all Americans.
paragraphs.zh: 2015年,美国林务局首次将其55亿美元年度预算的一半以上用于灭火,这一比例几乎是20年前的两倍。实际上,如今用于该机构其他工作的联邦资金减少了,这些工作包括森林保护、流域和文化资源管理以及基础设施维护,这些都影响着全体美国人的生活。

paragraphs.en: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts. As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire?
paragraphs.zh: 另一个全国性的关切是,来自其他机构的公共资金是否正流向火灾高发地区的建设。正如Moritz所说,联邦资金有多少次在建造可能毁于野火的房屋?

paragraphs.en: "It's already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country," he says. "We need to take a magnifying glass to that. Like, 'Wait a minute, is this OK?' Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?"
paragraphs.zh: 他说:"从公共支出的角度来看,这对整个国家来说已经是一个巨大的问题。我们需要用放大镜来审视这个问题。比如,'等一下,这样做可以吗?'我们是否应该将这些资金重新引导,集中用于地形中危险性较低的部分?"

paragraphs.en: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员表示,这种观点需要美国社会对火灾的看法发生相应的转变。

paragraphs.en: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive. Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change – how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
paragraphs.zh: 首先,关于野火的讨论需要更具包容性。过去十年,焦点一直集中在气候变化上,即温室气体导致的地球变暖如何造成恶化火灾的条件。

paragraphs.en: While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
paragraphs.zh: Moritz表示,虽然气候是一个关键因素,但不应以牺牲等式中的其他部分为代价。

paragraphs.en: "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says. Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be. Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
paragraphs.zh: 他说:"人类系统和我们生活的地貌是相互关联的,这种相互作用是双向的。"他指出,未能认识到这一点,会导致"对解决方案可能是什么产生过于简化的看法。我们对问题的认知和对解决方案的认知变得非常有限。"

paragraphs.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado. But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时,Colorado大学的Balch教授表示,人们继续将火灾视为需要完全控制、仅在必要时才释放的事件。但她说,承认火灾在人类生活中不可避免的存在,是制定使其尽可能安全的法律、政策和实践的关键态度。

paragraphs.en: "We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire," Balch says. "It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today."

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: Among the annoying challenges facing the middle class is one that will probably go unmentioned in the next presidential campaign: What happens when the robots come for their jobs? Don't dismiss that possibility entirely. About half of U.S. jobs are at high risk of being automated, according to a University of Oxford study, with the middle class disproportionately squeezed. Lower-income jobs like gardening or day care don't appeal to robots. But many middle-class occupations – trucking, financial advice, software engineering – have aroused their interest, or soon will. The rich own the robots, so they will be fine. This isn't to be alarmist. Optimists point out that technological upheaval has benefited workers in the past. The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed. Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work. But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting. The first step, as Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee argue in The Second Machine Age, should be rethinking education and job training. Curriculums – from grammar school to college – should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication. Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problem-solving skills and helping students work alongside robots. Online education can supplement the traditional kind. It could make extra training and instruction affordable. Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt. The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier. In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines. The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven't been invented yet. The U.S. needs the new companies that will invent them. Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought. Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality. Technology will improve society in ways big and small over the next few years, yet this will be little comfort to those who find their lives and careers upended by automation. Destroying the machines that are coming for our jobs would be nuts. But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable.
