reading.passage: Financial regulators in Britain have imposed a rather unusual rule on the bosses of big banks. Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing. The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions. Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decision-making, not only by banks but by all corporations, to build a stronger economy for future generations. "Short-termism" or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist, Andrew Haldane. He quotes a giant of classical economics, Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like "children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once" rather than putting them aside to be eaten last. The average time for holding a stock in both the United States and Britain, he notes, has dropped from seven years to seven months in recent decades. Transient investors, who demand high quarterly profits from companies, can hinder a firm's efforts to invest in long-term research or to build up customer loyalty. This has been dubbed "quarterly capitalism." In addition, new digital technologies have allowed more rapid trading of equities, quicker use of information, and thus shorter attention spans in financial markets. "There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing," said Commissioner Daniel Gallagher of the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a speech this week. In the US, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 has pushed most public companies to defer performance bonuses for senior executives by about a year, slightly helping reduce "short-termism." In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that "a substantial part" of executive pay is now tied to performance. Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism," such as changes in the tax code and quicker disclosure of stock acquisitions. In France, shareholders who hold onto a company investment for at least two years can sometimes earn more voting rights in a company. Within companies, the right compensation design can provide incentives for executives to think beyond their own time at the company and on behalf of all stakeholders. Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, one motive in imposing the new rule is to____
options: A) enhance bankers' sense of responsibility.
B) help corporations achieve larger profits.
C) build a new system of financial regulation.
D) guarantee the bonuses of top executives.
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 A）enhance bankers' sense of responsibility. 定位句在第 1 段：这条「追回」规则的主要目的，是让银行家为有害的冒险行为承担责任，并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。正确项与原文构成同义替换（hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking ↔ enhance bankers' sense of responsibility）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属过度推断、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Alfred Marshall is quoted to indicate____
options: A) the conditions for generating quick profits.
C) the solid structure of publicly traded companies.
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是例证目的题，正确答案 D）"short-termism" in economic activities. 定位句在第 2 段：英格兰银行首席经济学家 Andrew Haldane 说，「短期主义」——也就是追逐快钱的欲望——在上市公司中已日益严重。他援引古典经济学巨匠 Alfred Marshall 的话，把这种「金融上的不耐烦」描述为「孩子们把布丁里的李子先挑出来吃掉」，而不愿把它们留到最后吃。正确项与原文构成同义替换（"Short-termism" or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies ↔ "short-termism" in economic activities）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It is argued that the influence of transient investment on public companies can be____
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是推断题，正确答案 B）adverse. 定位句在第 3 段：短期投资者要求公司创造高额季度利润，他们会阻碍企业投入长期研发或培养客户忠诚度的努力。正确项与原文构成同义替换（can hinder a firm's efforts to invest in long-term research or to build up customer loyalty ↔ adverse）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The US and France examples are used to illustrate____
options: B) the significance of long-term thinking.
D) the prevalence of short-term thinking.
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是例证目的题，正确答案 C）the approaches to promoting "long-termism". 定位句在第 6 段：在鼓励「长期主义」上，可做的事还有很多，比如调整税法、加快股票交易披露。在法国，持有公司股份至少两年的股东有时可以获得更多投票权。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism" ↔ the approaches to promoting "long-termism"）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属答非所问、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
options: B) Patience as a Corporate Virtue
C) Decisiveness Required of Top Executives
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是主旨题，正确答案 B）Patience as a Corporate Virtue 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decision-making ↔ Patience as a Corporate Virtue；not just for the short term but for the long term ↔ Patience as a Corporate Virtue）。其余三项中，A 项属过度推断、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Financial regulators in Britain have imposed a rather unusual rule on the bosses of big banks. Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing. The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions. Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decision-making, not only by banks but by all corporations, to build a stronger economy for future generations.
paragraphs.zh: 英国金融监管机构对大型银行的高管实施了一项颇为不同寻常的规定。从明年开始,如果银行因不当行为受到调查,高管的任何保证奖金都可能被延迟十年发放。这项"追回"规定的主要目的是让银行家为有害的冒险行为负责,并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。然而,官员们还希望获得更大的益处:不仅银行,而且所有企业都能进行更多长期决策,从而为子孙后代建立更强大的经济。

paragraphs.en: "Short-termism" or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist, Andrew Haldane. He quotes a giant of classical economics, Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like "children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once" rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.
paragraphs.zh: 英格兰银行首席经济学家Andrew Haldane表示,"短期主义"或对快速利润的渴望,在上市公司中已经恶化。他引用古典经济学巨匠Alfred Marshall的话,将这种金融上的急躁描述为像"孩子们把布丁里的葡萄干挑出来立刻吃掉",而不是把它们留到最后再吃。

paragraphs.en: The average time for holding a stock in both the United States and Britain, he notes, has dropped from seven years to seven months in recent decades. Transient investors, who demand high quarterly profits from companies, can hinder a firm's efforts to invest in long-term research or to build up customer loyalty. This has been dubbed "quarterly capitalism."
paragraphs.zh: 他指出,近几十年来,在美国和英国,持有股票的平均时间已从七年降至七个月。要求公司获得高季度利润的短期投资者,可能会阻碍企业在长期研究方面的投资或建立客户忠诚度的努力。这被称为"季度资本主义"。

paragraphs.en: In addition, new digital technologies have allowed more rapid trading of equities, quicker use of information, and thus shorter attention spans in financial markets. "There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing," said Commissioner Daniel Gallagher of the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a speech this week.
paragraphs.zh: 此外,新的数字技术使股票交易更加迅速,信息使用更快,从而使金融市场的注意力持续时间更短。美国证券交易委员会委员Daniel Gallagher在本周的一次演讲中说:"似乎短期思维占主导地位,而长期投资受到了损害。"

paragraphs.en: In the US, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 has pushed most public companies to defer performance bonuses for senior executives by about a year, slightly helping reduce "short-termism." In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that "a substantial part" of executive pay is now tied to performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在美国,2002年的《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》已促使大多数上市公司将高级管理人员的绩效奖金推迟约一年发放,这在一定程度上有助于减少"短期主义"。《华尔街日报》在其最新的CEO薪酬调查中发现,高管薪酬的"很大一部分"现在与绩效挂钩。

paragraphs.en: Much more could be done to encourage "long-termism," such as changes in the tax code and quicker disclosure of stock acquisitions. In France, shareholders who hold onto a company investment for at least two years can sometimes earn more voting rights in a company.
paragraphs.zh: 可以做更多工作来鼓励"长期主义",例如修改税法和加快披露股票收购。在法国,持有公司投资至少两年的股东有时可以在公司中获得更多投票权。

paragraphs.en: Within companies, the right compensation design can provide incentives for executives to think beyond their own time at the company and on behalf of all stakeholders. Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.
paragraphs.zh: 在企业内部,正确的薪酬设计可以激励高管超越自己在公司任职的时间进行思考,并代表所有利益相关者的利益。英国的新规定提醒银行家,社会不仅对他们的短期表现感兴趣,而且对长期表现也感兴趣。

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: Grade inflation – the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades – is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased. But another, related force – a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called "grade forgiveness" – is helping raise GPAs. Grade forgiveness allows students to retake a course in which they received a low grade, and the most recent grade or the highest grade is the only one that counts in calculating a student's overall GPA. The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates. When this practice first started decades ago, it was usually limited to freshmen, to give them a second chance to take a class in their first year if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses. But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven. College officials tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty. "Ultimately," said Jack Miner, Ohio State University's registrar, "we see students achieve more success because they retake a course and do better in subsequent courses or master the content that allows them to graduate on time." That said, there is a way in which grade forgiveness satisfies colleges' own needs as well. For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention – so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money. And anything that raises GPAs will likely make students – who, at the end of the day, are paying the bill – feel they've gotten a better value for their tuition dollars, which is another big concern for colleges. Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education. Since students and parents expect a college degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible – or at least appear to be. On this, students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned.

questions.stem: What is commonly regarded as the cause of grade inflation?
options: A) The change of course catalogs.
D) The influence of consumer culture.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是细节题，正确答案 D）The influence of consumer culture. 定位句在第 1 段：“成绩通胀”——过去几十年间平均 GPA 的逐步上升——常被认为是高等教育消费时代的产物，在这个时代学生被当成需要取悦的顾客。正确项与原文构成同义替换（a product of a consumer era in higher education ↔ The influence of consumer culture）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: What was the original purpose of grade forgiveness?
options: A) To help freshmen adapt to college learning.
B) To maintain colleges' graduation rates.
C) To prepare graduates for a challenging future.
D) To increase universities' income from tuition.
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是细节题，正确答案 A）To help freshmen adapt to college learning. 定位句在第 3 段：几十年前这一做法刚开始时，通常只面向大一新生，目的是在他们适应大学课程遇到困难时给他们第二次重修该课的机会。正确项与原文构成同义替换（to give them a second chance ... if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses ↔ To help freshmen adapt to college learning）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 5, grade forgiveness enables colleges to____
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是细节题，正确答案 A）obtain more financial support. 定位句在第 5 段：对公立院校而言，州政府拨款有时部分挂钩于毕业率、学生留校率等指标——所以更高的成绩能通过抬升这些数字，意味着更多的经费。正确项与原文构成同义替换（state funds ... mean more money ↔ obtain more financial support）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What does the phrase "to be aligned" (Line 5, Para. 6) most probably mean?
options: C) To be identical with each other.
D) To be contradictory to each other.
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是词义句意题，正确答案 C）To be identical with each other. 定位句在第 6 段：既然学生和家长都指望一张大学文凭能带来一份工作，那么尽可能多产出“合格的”——或者至少看上去合格的——毕业生就符合学校的最大利益。在这一点上，学生和学校的动机似乎是一致的。正确项与原文构成同义替换（students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned ↔ To be identical with each other）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author examines the practice of grade forgiveness by____
options: B) analyzing the causes behind it.
C) comparing different views on it.
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是主旨题，正确答案 B）analyzing the causes behind it. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention – so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money ↔ analyzing the causes behind it；grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education ↔ analyzing the causes behind it）。其余三项中，A 项属答非所问、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Grade inflation – the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades – is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased. But another, related force – a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called "grade forgiveness" – is helping raise GPAs.
paragraphs.zh: 成绩膨胀——过去几十年来平均GPA(平均学分绩点)的逐渐上升——通常被认为是高等教育消费时代的产物,在这个时代学生被当作需要取悦的顾客来对待。但另一个相关的力量——一项常常深埋在课程目录中的被称为"成绩宽恕"的政策——正在帮助提高GPA。

paragraphs.en: Grade forgiveness allows students to retake a course in which they received a low grade, and the most recent grade or the highest grade is the only one that counts in calculating a student's overall GPA.
paragraphs.zh: 成绩宽恕允许学生重修他们获得低分的课程,而最近的成绩或最高的成绩是计算学生总GPA时唯一被计入的成绩。

paragraphs.en: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates. When this practice first started decades ago, it was usually limited to freshmen, to give them a second chance to take a class in their first year if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses. But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来,这种鲜为人知的做法的使用有所加速,因为各大学继续竭尽全力让学生留在学校(并支付学费)并提高他们的毕业率。当这种做法在几十年前首次开始时,它通常仅限于新生,如果他们在向大学水平课程过渡时遇到困难,给他们第二次机会在第一年重修课程。但现在大多数大学,除了许多选拔性校园之外,允许所有本科生甚至研究生获得低分宽恕。

paragraphs.en: College officials tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty. "Ultimately," said Jack Miner, Ohio State University's registrar, "we see students achieve more success because they retake a course and do better in subsequent courses or master the content that allows them to graduate on time."
paragraphs.zh: 大学官员倾向于强调成绩宽恕的目标更少关乎成绩本身,更多关乎鼓励学生重修对其学位项目和毕业至关重要的课程而不会招致重大惩罚。Ohio State University的教务长Jack Miner说:"最终,我们看到学生取得更多成功,因为他们重修了课程并在后续课程中表现更好,或者掌握了使他们能够按时毕业的内容。"

paragraphs.en: That said, there is a way in which grade forgiveness satisfies colleges' own needs as well. For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention – so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money. And anything that raises GPAs will likely make students – who, at the end of the day, are paying the bill – feel they've gotten a better value for their tuition dollars, which is another big concern for colleges.
paragraphs.zh: 话虽如此,成绩宽恕在某种程度上也满足了大学自身的需求。对于公立院校来说,州拨款有时部分与它们在毕业率和学生保留率等指标上的成功挂钩——因此更好的成绩可以通过提升这些数字来意味着更多的资金。而任何提高GPA的做法都可能让学生——归根结底是他们在付账——觉得他们的学费物有所值,这是大学的另一个重大关切。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education. Since students and parents expect a college degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible – or at least appear to be. On this, students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned.
paragraphs.zh: 事实上,成绩宽恕只是大学回应消费者对高等教育期望的另一种方式。由于学生和家长期望大学学位能带来工作,培养出尽可能合格的毕业生——或者至少看起来合格——符合学校的最大利益。在这一点上,学生和大学的动机似乎是一致的。

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of "Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus," by Mary Shelley. Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come. Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness? What makes humans humans?" What is being called artificial general intelligence, machines that would imitate the way humans think, continues to evade scientists. Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as "Westworld" and "Humans." Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist. "We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there." But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand. The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions. Human drivers sometimes must make split-second decisions. Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment. AI "vision" today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans. And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem. Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI. Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines. Britain is setting up a data ethics center. India released its AI ethics strategy this spring. On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms. It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights. While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point. So does the idea that decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair. To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values? Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein's out-of-control monster.

questions.stem: Mary Shelley's novel Frankenstein is mentioned because it____
options: A) fascinates AI scientists all over the world.
B) has remained popular for as long as 200 years.
C) involves some concerns raised by AI today.
D) has sparked serious ethical controversies.
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是例证目的题，正确答案 C）involves some concerns raised by AI today. 定位句在第 1 段：甚至在电灯发明之前，作者就写出了一部杰出的思辨小说，预示了后世技术将引发的诸多伦理问题。正确项与原文构成同义替换（foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come ↔ involves some concerns raised by AI today）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属答非所问、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: In David Eagleman's opinion, our current knowledge of consciousness____
options: B) can be misleading to robot making.
C) inspires popular sci-fi TV series.
D) is too limited for us to reproduce it.
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是细节题，正确答案 D）is too limited for us to reproduce it. 定位句在第 4 段：「我们的处境就是：目前根本没有像样的理论可以解释意识到底是什么、以及人怎么造出一台机器去抵达意识。」正确项与原文构成同义替换（no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there ↔ is too limited for us to reproduce it）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、C 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: The solution to the ethical issues brought by autonomous vehicles____
options: A) can hardly ever be found.
B) is still beyond our capacity.
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是细节题，正确答案 B）is still beyond our capacity. 定位句在第 5 段：今日 AI 的「视觉」远不及人类。要为每一种可以想象到的驾驶情景做预案，是一个困难的编程问题。正确项与原文构成同义替换（AI "vision" today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans. And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem. ↔ is still beyond our capacity）。其余三项中，A 项属过度推断、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward Google's pledges is one of____
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是态度题，正确答案 A）affirmation. 定位句在第 8 段：尽管这份声明措辞含糊，但它代表了一个起点。「AI 系统做出的决策应当可解释、透明、公正」这一理念，同样是一个起点。正确项与原文构成同义替换（it represents one starting point ↔ affirmation）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属过度推断、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
options: A) AI's Future: In the Hands of Tech Giants
B) Frankenstein, the Novel Predicting the Age of AI
C) The Conscience of AI: Complex But Inevitable
D) AI Shall Be Killers Once Out of Control
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是主旨题，正确答案 C）The Conscience of AI: Complex But Inevitable 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values? Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein's out-of-control monster. ↔ The Conscience of AI: Complex But Inevitable）。其余三项中，A 项属以偏概全、B 项属以偏概全、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of "Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus," by Mary Shelley. Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
paragraphs.zh: 今年恰逢玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦;或现代普罗米修斯》出版整整两个世纪。甚至在电灯泡发明之前,这位作者就创作出了一部非凡的推理小说,预示了未来技术将引发的许多伦理问题。

paragraphs.en: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness? What makes humans humans?"
paragraphs.zh: 如今人工智能的快速发展提出了根本性问题:"什么是智能、身份或意识?是什么使人之为人?"

paragraphs.en: What is being called artificial general intelligence, machines that would imitate the way humans think, continues to evade scientists. Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as "Westworld" and "Humans."
paragraphs.zh: 所谓的通用人工智能,即模仿人类思维方式的机器,仍然是科学家难以企及的目标。然而人类依然痴迷于机器人的想法,这些机器人能像人类一样外观、移动和反应,就像最近在热门科幻电视剧《西部世界》和《真实的人类》中描绘的那样。

paragraphs.en: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist. "We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there."
paragraphs.zh: 斯坦福大学神经科学家David Eagleman说,人类的思维方式仍然过于复杂而无法被理解,更不用说复制了。"我们正处于这样一种境地:没有好的理论能解释意识究竟是什么,以及你如何才能建造一台机器来实现它。"

paragraphs.en: But that doesn't mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren't at hand. The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions. Human drivers sometimes must make split-second decisions. Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment. AI "vision" today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans. And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.
paragraphs.zh: 但这并不意味着涉及人工智能的关键伦理问题不在眼前。例如,即将到来的自动驾驶车辆的使用就提出了棘手的伦理问题。人类驾驶员有时必须做出瞬间决策。他们的反应可能是即时反射、过往驾驶经验输入以及当时眼睛和耳朵告诉他们的信息的复杂组合。如今人工智能的"视觉"远不如人类复杂。而且预测每一种可以想象的驾驶情况是一个困难的编程问题。

paragraphs.en: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI. Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines. Britain is setting up a data ethics center. India released its AI ethics strategy this spring.
paragraphs.zh: 新加坡一家帮助政府制定人工智能伦理使用自愿准则的机构首席执行官Tan Kiat How指出,每当决策基于海量数据时,"你很快就会遇到许多伦理问题"。除了新加坡,其他政府和大型企业也开始建立自己的指导方针。英国正在建立一个数据伦理中心。印度在今年春天发布了其人工智能伦理战略。

paragraphs.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to "design or deploy AI" that would cause "overall harm," or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms. It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
paragraphs.zh: 6月7日,Google承诺不会"设计或部署"会造成"整体伤害"的人工智能,也不会开发人工智能制导武器或将人工智能用于违反国际规范的监控。它还承诺不部署其使用会违反国际法或人权的人工智能。

paragraphs.en: While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point. So does the idea that decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然这一声明比较模糊,但它代表了一个起点。人工智能系统做出的决策应该是可解释的、透明的和公平的这一理念也是如此。

paragraphs.en: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values? Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein's out-of-control monster.
paragraphs.zh: 换句话说:我们如何确保智能机器的思维反映人类的最高价值观?只有这样,它们才会成为有用的仆人,而不是弗兰肯斯坦失控的怪物。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states. The Supreme Court's opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually. The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases. The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer's purchase to a state where the business didn't have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state. Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid. Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed. "Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States," he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices. Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field." The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already. Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before. Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to. Amazon.com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don't have to. Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states. Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven't been collecting sales tax nationwide. Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state's sales tax from customers and send it to the state. Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses. The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones. Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws. The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, "Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision."

questions.stem: The Supreme Court decision Thursday will____
options: A) better businesses' relations with states.
B) put most online businesses in a dilemma.
C) make more online shoppers pay sales tax.
D) force some states to cut sales tax.
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 C）make more online shoppers pay sales tax. 定位句在第 1 段：根据周四最高法院的一项判决，各州将能强制更多人在网购时缴纳销售税；该判决会让购物者钱包变瘦，但对各州而言是一场重大的财政胜利。正确项与原文构成同义替换（States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases ↔ make more online shoppers pay sales tax）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属以偏概全、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from paragraphs 2 and 3 that the overruled decisions____
options: A) have led to the dominance of e-commerce.
B) have cost consumers a lot over the years.
C) were widely criticized by online purchasers.
D) were considered unfavorable by states.
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是细节题，正确答案 D）were considered unfavorable by states. 定位句在第 2 段：周四最高法院的意见推翻了一对存在数十年的旧判决——各州称这些旧判决每年让它们损失数十亿美元的税收。正确项与原文构成同义替换（states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually ↔ were considered unfavorable by states）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Justice Anthony Kennedy, the physical presence rule has____
options: B) brought prosperity to the country.
D) boosted growth in states' revenue.
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是细节题，正确答案 C）harmed fair market competition. 定位句在第 4 段：Kennedy 写道，该规则限制了各州追求长期繁荣的能力，并阻止了市场参与者在公平的竞争环境中角逐。正确项与原文构成同义替换（has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field ↔ harmed fair market competition）。其余三项中，A 项属过度推断、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling?
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是细节题，正确答案 B）Big-chain owners. 定位句在第 5 段：这项判决是大型连锁企业的一场胜利，因为这些在多州都有实体的连锁本来就大多已经在为网购代收销售税。正确项与原文构成同义替换（a victory for big chains with a presence in many states ↔ Big-chain owners）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: In dealing with the Supreme Court decision Thursday, the author____
options: A) gives a factual account of it and discusses its consequences.
B) describes the long and complicated process of its making.
C) presents its main points with conflicting views on them.

questions.explanation: 第 40 题是主旨题，正确答案 A）gives a factual account of it and discusses its consequences. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday ↔ gives a factual account of it；Retail trade groups praised the ruling ↔ discusses its consequences）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属过度推断、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
paragraphs.zh: 根据最高法院周四的一项裁决,各州将能够强制更多人在网上购物时缴纳销售税,这将使购物者的钱包变轻,但对各州来说是一次重大的财政胜利。

paragraphs.en: The Supreme Court's opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually. The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.
paragraphs.zh: 最高法院周四的意见推翻了一对有数十年历史的判决,各州称这些判决每年使它们损失数十亿美元的税收收入。这些判决使各州更难对某些网上购物征收销售税。

paragraphs.en: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer's purchase to a state where the business didn't have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state. Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid.
paragraphs.zh: 法院推翻的案例规定,如果企业将客户购买的商品运送到该企业在该州没有实体存在(如仓库或办公室)的州,该企业就不必为该州征收销售税。如果没有被收取销售税,客户通常有责任自己向州缴纳销售税,但大多数人没有意识到自己欠税,很少有人缴纳。

paragraphs.en: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed. "Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States," he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices. Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
paragraphs.zh: 大法官Anthony Kennedy写道,之前的判决存在缺陷。他在一份由其他四位大法官共同签署的意见书中写道:'实体存在规则每年都在进一步脱离经济现实,并给各州造成重大税收损失。'Kennedy写道,该规则'限制了各州寻求长期繁荣的能力,并阻止了市场参与者在公平的竞争环境中竞争。'

paragraphs.en: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already. Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before. Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to. Amazon.com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don't have to.
paragraphs.zh: 这项裁决对在许多州都有实体存在的大型连锁企业来说是一次胜利,因为它们通常已经对网上购物征收销售税。现在,竞争对手将在以前没有征收销售税的地方征收销售税。大型连锁企业一直在全国范围内征收销售税,因为它们通常在购买商品运送到的任何州都有实体店。Amazon.com凭借其仓库网络,也在每个征收销售税的州征收销售税,尽管使用该网站的第三方卖家不必这样做。

paragraphs.en: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states. Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven't been collecting sales tax nationwide. Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state's sales tax from customers and send it to the state.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止,许多仅在单个州或少数几个州有实体存在的卖家在向这些州以外的地址发货时能够避免征收销售税。使用eBay和Etsy的卖家(这些平台为小型卖家提供服务)也一直没有在全国范围内征收销售税。根据周四的裁决,各州可以通过法律,要求外州卖家向客户征收该州的销售税并将其上缴给该州。

paragraphs.en: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses. The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones. Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws. The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, "Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision."
paragraphs.zh: 零售贸易团体称赞这项裁决,称其为本地和网上企业创造了公平的竞争环境。零售分析师Neil Saunders说,输家是纯网上零售商,尤其是较小的零售商。这些零售商在遵守各州不同的销售税法时可能会面临麻烦。小企业与创业委员会倡导组织在一份声明中说:'小企业和互联网创业者完全没有从这项裁决中得到良好的服务。'

blanks.explanation: 第 1 空正确答案 C）Few。后文 But 转折反推此句应是少数。其余三项：A）Some 量级不够极端、B）Most 方向相反、D）All 过于绝对且方向反，均可排除。
第 2 空正确答案 C）run。run on = 靠……运转。其余三项：A）put 无 put on batteries 此义、B）take take on 义不对、D）come come on 义不对，均可排除。
第 3 空正确答案 B）If。迷路是假设、给招是结果。其余三项：A）Since 因果不成立、C）Though 让步无对立、D）Until 时间义说不通，均可排除。
第 4 空正确答案 D）literally。强调‘真的连北都找不到’。其余三项：A）formally 正式地，语义无关、B）relatively 相对地，削弱了语气、C）gradually 渐渐地，时间义不合，均可排除。
第 5 空正确答案 A）back。迷路后是‘返回’文明。其余三项：B）next next to 是‘紧挨’、C）around 绕行，方向不对、D）away 方向完全相反，均可排除。
第 6 空正确答案 B）off。与‘但不在完全陌生处’呼应。其余三项：A）onto 方向相反，是‘到小径上’、C）across 横穿，语义不合、D）alone 形近干扰，不是介词，均可排除。
第 7 空正确答案 D）unfamiliar。承接 off a trail 的‘陌生’。其余三项：A）unattractive 不吸引人，话题无关、B）uncrowded 不拥挤，维度不符、C）unchanged 未改变，逻辑无着落，均可排除。
第 8 空正确答案 C）way。问的是‘哪个方向是下坡’。其余三项：A）site site 指‘地点’非方向、B）point point 是‘点’，方向义弱、D）place place 指‘地方’非方向，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 A）So。前句给依据、本句出结论。其余三项：B）Yet 转折，无对立可转、C）Instead 替代，缺被替换项、D）Besides 递进，非新增信息，均可排除。
第 10 空正确答案 D）eventually。‘走、跟着水’是渐进过程。其余三项：A）immediately 立刻，与过程矛盾、B）intentionally 故意地，方式义不通、C）unexpectedly 出乎意料，与‘should’冲突，均可排除。
第 11 空正确答案 A）surprised。‘多快就能恢复方向感’是积极意外。其余三项：B）annoyed 恼火，色彩相反、C）frightened 害怕，与好结果冲突、D）confused 困惑，与‘恢复方向’矛盾，均可排除。
第 12 空正确答案 B）option。前文是一条条‘自救办法’。其余三项：A）problem 问题，与‘给办法’相反、C）view 观点/景色，定性不符、D）result 结果，逻辑颠倒，均可排除。
第 13 空正确答案 D）For example。本句是对‘登高找人迹’的具体例示。其余三项：A）Above all 最重要的是，无主次比较、B）In contrast 相反，无对立、C）On average 平均而言，无数据语境，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 C）spot。目的是‘发现’缺口以找出路。其余三项：A）bridge 架桥/弥合，动作不合、B）avoid 避开，与‘朝它走’相反、D）separate 分开，动作无对象逻辑，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 B）through。小路是‘穿过’树林开出的。其余三项：A）from from 表来源，方位不合、C）beyond beyond 表‘在……之外’、D）under under 表‘在……下方’，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 D）breaks。these 复指上句的 gaps。其余三项：A）posts 柱子/岗位，非缺口、B）links 连接/链接，义相反、C）shades 阴影/色调，话题无关，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 A）artificial。such as fires and streetlights 是人造光。其余三项：B）mysterious 神秘的，与‘找人’无关、C）hidden 隐藏的，与‘扫视寻找’矛盾、D）limited 有限的，无关属性，均可排除。
第 18 空正确答案 A）Finally。全文并列多招、此为最后一招。其余三项：B）Consequently 因此，无因果可承、C）Incidentally 顺便一提，分量不符、D）Generally 一般而言，非收尾义，均可排除。
第 19 空正确答案 B）marks。下句举例 Trail blazes, tire tracks 都是‘痕迹’。其余三项：A）memories 记忆，不能留在地貌上、C）notes 笔记/便条，范围太窄、D）belongings 随身物品，与例子不符，均可排除。
第 20 空正确答案 C）lead。与首段‘navigate back to civilization’呼应。其余三项：A）restrict 限制，方向相反、B）adopt 采纳/收养，搭配不成立、D）expose 暴露，搭配与义皆不合，均可排除。

But phones [2] on batteries, and batteries can die faster than we realize. reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms. Children aren't born knowing how to say "I'm sorry"; rather, they learn over time that such statements appease parents and friends – and their own consciences. This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing. In the popular imagination, of course, guilt still gets a bad rap. It is deeply uncomfortable – it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones. Yet this understanding is outdated. "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another. Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities. Too much happiness can be destructive. And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships. Guilt, in other words, can help hold a cooperative species together. It is a kind of social glue. Viewed in this light, guilt is an opportunity. Work by Tina Malti, a psychology professor at the University of Toronto, suggests that guilt may compensate for an emotional deficiency. In a number of studies, Malti and others have shown that guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing. Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses. And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt. In a 2014 study, for example, Malti looked at 244 children. Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions. Then the kids were handed chocolate coins, and given a chance to share them with an anonymous child. For the low-sympathy kids, how much they shared appeared to turn on how inclined they were to feel guilty. The guilt-prone ones shared more, even though they hadn't magically become more sympathetic to the other child's deprivation. "That's good news," Malti says. "We can be prosocial because we caused harm and we feel regret."

questions.stem: Researchers think that guilt can be a good thing because it may help____.
options: A) regulate a child's basic emotions
B) improve a child's intellectual ability
C) foster a child's moral development
D) intensify a child's positive feelings
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 C）foster a child's moral development 定位句在第 1 段：这就是研究者通常将所谓的'道德罪疚感'——在适度范围内——视作一件好事的原因。正确项与原文构成同义替换（in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms ↔ foster a child's moral development；regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing ↔ foster a child's moral development）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, many people still consider guilt to be____.
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 B）burdensome 定位句在第 2 段：当然，在大众的印象里，罪疚感仍然名声不佳。它令人极度不适——情感上相当于穿了一件灌满石头的夹克。正确项与原文构成同义替换（wearing a jacket weighted with stones ↔ burdensome；guilt still gets a bad rap ↔ burdensome）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: Vaish holds that the rethinking about guilt comes from an awareness that____.
options: C) emotional stability can benefit health
D) an emotion can play opposing roles
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是细节题，正确答案 D）an emotion can play opposing roles 定位句在第 2 段：弗吉尼亚大学心理学研究者 Amrisha Vaish 说：'对于罪疚是什么、能起到什么作用，目前出现了某种复兴或重新思考。'她补充说，这种复兴是一种更宏观认识的一部分——情绪并非二元的，在某个情境中可能有益的感受，在另一个情境中可能有害。正确项与原文构成同义替换（emotions aren't binary ↔ an emotion can play opposing roles；feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another ↔ an emotion can play opposing roles）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Malti and others have shown that cooperation and sharing____.
options: A) may help correct emotional deficiencies
B) can result from either sympathy or guilt
C) can bring about emotional satisfaction
D) may be the outcome of impulsive acts
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是细节题，正确答案 B）can result from either sympathy or guilt 定位句在第 4 段：在若干研究中，Malti 等人已证明，罪疚和同情心可能代表通向合作与分享的两条不同路径。正确项与原文构成同义替换（guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing ↔ can result from either sympathy or guilt；Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt ↔ can result from either sympathy or guilt）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The word "transgressions" (Line 4, Para. 5) is closest in meaning to____.
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是词义句意题，正确答案 D）wrongdoings 定位句在第 5 段：她借助照护者的评估与儿童的自我观察，对每个孩子的总体同情水平、以及在道德越界行为之后感受到负面情绪的倾向分别打分。正确项与原文构成同义替换（moral transgressions ↔ wrongdoings；feel negative emotions after moral transgressions ↔ wrongdoings）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属答非所问、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms. Children aren't born knowing how to say "I'm sorry"; rather, they learn over time that such statements appease parents and friends – and their own consciences. This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing.
paragraphs.zh: 与所谓的悲伤、恐惧和愤怒等基本情绪不同,内疚出现得稍晚一些,与儿童对社会和道德规范的理解不断增强相伴而生。孩子们并非生来就知道如何说"对不起";相反,他们随着时间推移逐渐了解到这样的表述能够安抚父母和朋友——以及他们自己的良心。这就是为什么研究人员普遍认为,适量的所谓道德内疚是一件好事。

paragraphs.en: In the popular imagination, of course, guilt still gets a bad rap. It is deeply uncomfortable – it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones. Yet this understanding is outdated. "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another. Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities. Too much happiness can be destructive.
paragraphs.zh: 当然,在大众想象中,内疚仍然名声不佳。它令人深感不适——就像穿着一件装满石头的沉重外套。然而这种理解已经过时了。"人们对内疚是什么以及内疚能发挥什么作用进行了某种复兴或重新思考,"弗吉尼亚大学的心理学研究员Amrisha Vaish说道,并补充说这种复兴是更广泛认识的一部分,即情绪不是二元的——在某种情境下可能有利的情感在另一种情境下可能有害。例如,嫉妒和愤怒可能是进化出来提醒我们注意重要的不平等现象的。过多的快乐可能具有破坏性。

paragraphs.en: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships. Guilt, in other words, can help hold a cooperative species together. It is a kind of social glue.
paragraphs.zh: 而内疚,通过促使我们更深入地思考自己的善良,可以鼓励人类弥补错误和修复关系。换句话说,内疚可以帮助维系一个合作型物种。它是一种社会黏合剂。

paragraphs.en: Viewed in this light, guilt is an opportunity. Work by Tina Malti, a psychology professor at the University of Toronto, suggests that guilt may compensate for an emotional deficiency. In a number of studies, Malti and others have shown that guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing. Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses. And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt.
paragraphs.zh: 从这个角度来看,内疚是一个机会。多伦多大学心理学教授Tina Malti的研究表明,内疚可能弥补情感上的不足。在多项研究中,Malti和其他研究者已经表明,内疚和同情可能代表通往合作和分享的不同途径。一些同情心较低的孩子可能通过体验更多内疚来弥补这一缺陷,这可以约束他们更恶劣的冲动。反之亦然:高同情心可以替代低内疚感。

paragraphs.en: In a 2014 study, for example, Malti looked at 244 children. Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions. Then the kids were handed chocolate coins, and given a chance to share them with an anonymous child. For the low-sympathy kids, how much they shared appeared to turn on how inclined they were to feel guilty. The guilt-prone ones shared more, even though they hadn't magically become more sympathetic to the other child's deprivation.
paragraphs.zh: 例如,在2014年的一项研究中,Malti观察了244名儿童。利用看护者评估和儿童的自我观察,她评定了每个孩子的整体同情心水平以及他或她在道德过失后感受负面情绪的倾向。然后孩子们得到了巧克力硬币,并有机会与一个匿名儿童分享。对于同情心较低的孩子,他们分享多少似乎取决于他们有多倾向于感到内疚。容易感到内疚的孩子分享得更多,尽管他们并没有神奇地对另一个孩子的匮乏变得更有同情心。

paragraphs.en: "That's good news," Malti says. "We can be prosocial because we caused harm and we feel regret."
paragraphs.zh: "这是个好消息,"Malti说。"我们可以表现出亲社会行为,因为我们造成了伤害并感到后悔。"

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: Forests give us shade, quiet and one of the harder challenges in the fight against climate change. Even as we humans count on forests to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide we produce, we are threatening their ability to do so. The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb. Thankfully, there is a way out of this trap – but it involves striking a subtle balance. Helping forests flourish as valuable "carbon sinks" long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now. California is leading the way, as it does on so many climate efforts, in figuring out the details. The state's proposed Forest Carbon Plan aims to double efforts to thin out young trees and clear brush in parts of the forest. This temporarily lowers carbon-carrying capacity. But the remaining trees draw a greater share of the available moisture, so they grow and thrive, restoring the forest's capacity to pull carbon from the air. Healthy trees are also better able to fend off insects. The landscape is rendered less easily burnable. Even in the event of a fire, fewer trees are consumed. The need for such planning is increasingly urgent. Already, since 2010, drought and insects have killed over 100 million trees in California, most of them in 2016 alone, and wildfires have burned hundreds of thousands of acres. California plans to treat 35,000 acres of forest a year by 2020, and 60,000 by 2030 – financed from the proceeds of the state's emissions-permit auctions. That's only a small share of the total acreage that could benefit, about half a million acres in all, so it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought. The strategy also aims to ensure that carbon in woody material removed from the forests is locked away in the form of solid lumber or burned as biofuel in vehicles that would otherwise run on fossil fuels. New research on transportation biofuels is already under way. State governments are well accustomed to managing forests, but traditionally they've focused on wildlife, watersheds and opportunities for recreation. Only recently have they come to see the vital part forests will have to play in storing carbon. California's plan, which is expected to be finalized by the governor next year, should serve as a model.

questions.stem: By saying "one of the harder challenges," the author implies that____.
options: A) global climate change may get out of control
B) people may misunderstand global warming
C) extreme weather conditions may arise
D) forests may become a potential threat
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是推断题，正确答案 D）forests may become a potential threat 定位句在第 1 段：尽管人类指望森林吸走我们排放的大量二氧化碳，但我们正在威胁它们的这种能力。我们正在加速的气候变化有朝一日可能让森林排放的碳比吸收的还要多。正确项与原文构成同义替换（could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb ↔ forests may become a potential threat）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: To maintain forests as valuable "carbon sinks," we may need to____.
options: A) preserve the diversity of species in them
B) accelerate the growth of young trees
C) strike a balance among different plants
D) lower their present carbon-absorbing capacity
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是细节题，正确答案 D）lower their present carbon-absorbing capacity 定位句在第 2 段：要帮助森林作为宝贵的"碳汇"长期繁荣下去，可能需要降低它们当下的吸碳能力。正确项与原文构成同义替换（may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now ↔ lower their present carbon-absorbing capacity）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: California's Forest Carbon Plan endeavors to____.
options: B) reduce the density of some of its forests
C) find more effective ways to kill insects
D) restore its forests quickly after wildfires
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是细节题，正确答案 B）reduce the density of some of its forests 定位句在第 3 段：该州拟议的《森林碳计划》旨在加倍投入，在部分森林中疏伐幼树、清除灌木。正确项与原文构成同义替换（thin out young trees and clear brush in parts of the forest ↔ reduce the density of some of its forests）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What is essential to California's plan according to Paragraph 5?
options: A) To handle the areas in serious danger first.
B) To carry it out before the year of 2020.
C) To perfect the emissions-permit auctions.
D) To obtain enough financial support.
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是细节题，正确答案 A）To handle the areas in serious danger first. 定位句在第 5 段：这只是可受益总面积（约 50 万英亩）的一小部分，所以优先处理火灾或干旱风险最高的区域将至关重要。正确项与原文构成同义替换（prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought ↔ To handle the areas in serious danger first.）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author's attitude to California's plan can best be described as____.
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是态度题，正确答案 C）supportive 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（should serve as a model ↔ supportive；California is leading the way ↔ supportive）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: American farmers have been complaining of labor shortages for several years. The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers. Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa for agricultural workers that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry. If this doesn't change, American businesses, communities, and consumers will be the losers. Perhaps half of U.S. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants. As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing. Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single. They're also aging. At the start of this century, about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35. Now more than half are. And picking crops is hard on older bodies. One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm. Mechanization isn't the answer, either – not yet, at least. Production of corn, cotton, rice, soybeans, and wheat has been largely mechanized, but many high-value, labor-intensive crops, such as strawberries, need labor. Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they're automated. As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce. Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled. The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year. Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need. The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable. One survey found that bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late. The shortage is compounded by federal immigration raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground. In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor. Some western farmers have responded by moving operations to Mexico. From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported. Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent. In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.

questions.stem: What problem should be addressed according to the first two paragraphs?
options: A) Discrimination against foreign workers in the U.S.
B) Biased laws in favor of some American businesses.
C) Flaws in U.S. immigration rules for farm workers.
D) Decline of job opportunities in U.S. agriculture.
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是细节题，正确答案 C）Flaws in U.S. immigration rules for farm workers. 定位句在第 1 段：如果不彻底改革针对农场工人的移民规则，这些抱怨不太可能停止。正确项与原文构成同义替换（an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers ↔ Flaws in U.S. immigration rules for farm workers；immigration rules for farm workers ↔ U.S. immigration rules for farm workers）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: One trouble with U.S. agricultural workforce is____.
options: A) the rising number of illegal immigrants
B) the high mobility of crop workers
C) the lack of experienced laborers
D) the aging of immigrant farm workers
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是细节题，正确答案 D）the aging of immigrant farm workers 定位句在第 3 段：他们也在变老。本世纪初，约三分之一的农作物工人年龄超过 35 岁。如今超过一半的人都过了 35 岁。而采摘庄稼对年长的身体来说很吃力。正确项与原文构成同义替换（They're also aging. ↔ the aging of immigrant farm workers；Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico ↔ immigrant farm workers）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: What is the much-argued solution to the labor shortage in U.S. farming?
options: A) To attract younger laborers to farm work.
B) To get native U.S. workers back to farming.
C) To use more robots to grow high-value crops.
D) To strengthen financial support for farmers.
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是细节题，正确答案 B）To get native U.S. workers back to farming. 定位句在第 3 段：对于这一劳动力短缺，一个常被讨论的「解药」依然像一直以来那样不靠谱：本土美国工人不会重返农场。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm ↔ To get native U.S. workers back to farming；to the farm ↔ to farming）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Agricultural employers complain about the H-2A visa for its____.
options: B) limit on duration of stay
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是细节题，正确答案 A）slow granting procedures 定位句在第 6 段：（H-2A 的）流程繁琐、昂贵且不可靠。一项调查发现，官僚拖延使平均 H-2A 工人比预定到岗日晚到 22 天。正确项与原文构成同义替换（bureaucratic delays ↔ slow granting procedures；cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable ↔ slow granting procedures；arrive on the job 22 days late ↔ slow granting procedures）。其余三项中，B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following could be the best title for this text?
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是主旨题，正确答案 B）Import Food or Labor? 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it ↔ Import Food or Labor?；From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported. paragraphs.zh: 美国农民多年来一直抱怨劳动力短缺。如果不对农业工人的移民规定进行全面改革,这些抱怨不太可能停止。

paragraphs.en: Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa for agricultural workers that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry. If this doesn't change, American businesses, communities, and consumers will be the losers.
paragraphs.zh: 国会一直阻挠为农业工人创建更简便签证的努力,这种签证将允许外国工人在美国停留更长时间并在该行业内更换工作。如果这种情况不改变,美国企业、社区和消费者将成为输家。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps half of U.S. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants. As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing. Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single. They're also aging. At the start of this century, about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35. Now more than half are. And picking crops is hard on older bodies. One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm.
paragraphs.zh: 美国农场劳动力中大约有一半是无证移民。随着此类工人进入该国的人数减少,农业劳动力的特征正在发生变化。今天的农场劳动者虽然仍以在墨西哥出生为主,但更可能是定居而非迁徙,更可能是已婚而非单身。他们也在老龄化。在本世纪初,约三分之一的农作物工人年龄在35岁以上。现在超过一半。而且采摘农作物对年长的身体来说很艰难。对于这种劳动力短缺,一个经常被辩论的解决方案仍然像一直以来那样不切实际:本土美国工人不会回到农场。

paragraphs.en: Mechanization isn't the answer, either – not yet, at least. Production of corn, cotton, rice, soybeans, and wheat has been largely mechanized, but many high-value, labor-intensive crops, such as strawberries, need labor. Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they're automated.
paragraphs.zh: 机械化也不是答案——至少目前还不是。玉米、棉花、水稻、大豆和小麦的生产已经基本实现机械化,但许多高价值、劳动密集型作物,如草莓,需要劳动力。即使是奶牛场,机器人只完成一小部分挤奶工作,离自动化还有很长的路要走。

paragraphs.en: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce. Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled.
paragraphs.zh: 因此,农场越来越依赖使用H-2A签证的临时客工来填补劳动力缺口。大约从2012年开始,签证申请急剧上升;从2011年到2016年,签证发放数量增加了一倍多。

paragraphs.en: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year. Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need. The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable. One survey found that bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late. The shortage is compounded by federal immigration raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground.
paragraphs.zh: H-2A签证没有数量上限,不像用于非农业工作的H-2B签证,后者每年限制在66000个。即便如此,雇主仍抱怨他们没有得到所需的全部工人。这一过程繁琐、昂贵且不可靠。一项调查发现,官僚主义的延误导致H-2A工人平均晚到岗22天。联邦移民突击检查加剧了短缺,这些检查驱逐了一些工人并迫使其他工人转入地下。

paragraphs.en: In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor. Some western farmers have responded by moving operations to Mexico. From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported. Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent.
paragraphs.zh: 在2012年的一项调查中,71%的果树种植者和近80%的葡萄干和浆果种植者表示他们劳动力短缺。一些西部农民的应对方式是将业务转移到墨西哥。从1998年到2000年,美国人消费的水果中有14.5%是进口的。仅仅十多年后,进口份额达到了25.8%。

paragraphs.en: In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上,美国可以进口食品,或者可以进口采摘食品的工人。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic. They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day – encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis. The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics. But the overarching message is directed at individuals. My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved. On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us. They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge. While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change. It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority – or even most people's. We shouldn't expect it to be. In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural. This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether. India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022." There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal. DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment. It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior. None of this is about writing off the individual. It's just about putting things into perspective. We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.

questions.stem: Some celebrities star in a new video to____.
options: A) demand new laws on the use of plastics
B) urge consumers to cut the use of plastics
C) invite public opinion on the plastics crisis
D) disclose the causes of the plastics crisis
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 B）urge consumers to cut the use of plastics 定位句在第 1 段：他们是为世界环境日拍摄新视频的一批明星之一——视频鼓励作为消费者的你换掉吸管、餐具等一次性塑料常用品，以抗击塑料危机。正确项与原文构成同义替换（encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery ↔ urge consumers to cut the use of plastics）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author is concerned that "moral licensing" may____.
options: A) mislead us into doing worthless things
B) prevent us from making further efforts
C) weaken our sense of accomplishment
D) suppress our desire for success
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是细节题，正确答案 B）prevent us from making further efforts 定位句在第 3 段：这些（小动作）甚至可能有害：满足了我们「做了一点贡献」的需要，却让我们再也不去追求更大、更勇敢、更有效的行动——这是一种「道德许可」效应，它平息了我们的担忧，让我们停下来不再多做、也不再多要求当权者。正确项与原文构成同义替换（stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge ↔ prevent us from making further efforts；without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions ↔ prevent us from making further efforts）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: By pointing out our identity "citizens", the author indicates that____.
options: A) our focus should be shifted to community welfare
B) our relationship with local industries is improving
C) we have been actively exercising our civil rights
D) we should press our government to lead the combat
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是推断题，正确答案 D）we should press our government to lead the combat 定位句在第 4 段：当关于环境和我们对它的责任的讨论仍停留在购物袋和吸管上时，我们忽视了背后的权力关系——这种关系暗示我们作为「消费者」要可持续地购物，而不是作为「公民」追究政府和企业的责任、推动真正的系统性变革。正确项与原文构成同义替换（hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change ↔ press our government to lead the combat）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: DeSombre argues that the best way for a collective change should be____.
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是细节题，正确答案 D）a top-down process 定位句在第 5 段：Wellesley 学院的 Elizabeth R. DeSombre 教授在新书《为什么好人做坏环境的事》中主张：要在大群体范围内改变行为，最好的办法是让改变是「结构性」的。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural ↔ a top-down process；implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether ↔ a top-down process）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author concludes that individual efforts____.
questions.explanation: 第 40 题是主旨题，正确答案 C）are far from sufficient 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us ↔ are far from sufficient；individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior ↔ are far from sufficient；We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change ↔ are far from sufficient）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic. They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day – encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.
paragraphs.zh: Arnold Schwarzenegger、Dia Mirza和Adrian Grenier向你传递一个信息:战胜塑料很容易。他们是为世界环境日拍摄新视频的一群名人中的一部分,该视频鼓励你这样的消费者,用可替代品取代你的一次性塑料必需品,如吸管和餐具,以应对塑料危机。

paragraphs.en: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics. But the overarching message is directed at individuals.
paragraphs.zh: 为世界环境日整合的关键信息确实包括呼吁政府制定法律来遏制一次性塑料。但总体信息是针对个人的。

paragraphs.en: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved. On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us. They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
paragraphs.zh: 然而,我对把这件事留给个人的担忧在于,我们对需要实现什么目标的认识有限。例如,仅靠我们自己带购物袋去杂货店或戒掉塑料吸管,将取得很少成就,也只需要我们付出很少。它们甚至可能是有害的,满足了一种'我们已经尽力'的需求,却从未进展到更大、更大胆、更有效的行动——一种'道德许可',它缓解了我们的担忧,阻止我们做更多事情和向掌权者要求更多。

paragraphs.en: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.
paragraphs.zh: 当围绕我们的环境和我们对环境的责任的讨论仍然集中在购物袋和吸管上时,我们忽略了权力平衡,这种平衡意味着作为'消费者',我们必须可持续地购物,而不是作为'公民'追究我们的政府和行业的责任,推动真正的系统性变革。

paragraphs.en: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority – or even most people's. We shouldn't expect it to be. In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.
paragraphs.zh: 重要的是要承认,环境并不是每个人的优先事项——甚至不是大多数人的优先事项。我们不应该期望它是。在她的最新著作《为什么好人做坏的环境事》中,Wellesley College教授Elizabeth R. DeSombre认为,集体改变大量人群行为的最佳方式是让改变成为结构性的。

paragraphs.en: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether. India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022." There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal.
paragraphs.zh: 这可能意味着实施政策,如塑料税,为环境问题行为增加成本,或者完全禁止一次性塑料。印度刚刚宣布将'在2022年之前消除该国所有一次性塑料'。还有基于激励的方式使更好的环境选择变得更容易,例如确保回收至少与垃圾处理一样容易。

paragraphs.en: DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment. It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
paragraphs.zh: DeSombre并不是说人们应该停止关心环境。她说,只是个人行动太慢了,不能成为改变广泛行为的唯一甚至主要方法。

paragraphs.en: None of this is about writing off the individual. It's just about putting things into perspective. We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些都不是要否定个人。这只是关乎正确看待事物。我们没有时间等待。我们需要塑造集体行动(并约束污染企业)的进步政策,以及推动变革的积极公民。
