blanks.explanation: 第 1 空正确答案 A）coined。主语是 the term（一个新名称）。其余三项：B）discovered 义偏：术语是被造不是被发现、C）collected 搭配不当：术语不被「收集」、D）issued 义偏：issue 指发布文件/命令，均可排除。
第 2 空正确答案 C）compared。compare A to B = 把A比作B。其余三项：A）attributed 义偏：attribute to 是「归因于」、B）directed 义偏：direct to 是「指向/引导」、D）confined 义偏：confine to 是「限制在」，均可排除。
第 3 空正确答案 D）Though。主句有 nonetheless，标志让步转折。其余三项：A）Unless 逻辑反：unless 表「除非」否定条件、B）When 逻辑弱：when 只表时间，无让步味、C）Once 逻辑偏：once 表「一旦」条件，均可排除。
第 4 空正确答案 C）hinted at。全文立场：植物意识只是「迹象」非定论。其余三项：A）coped with 义偏：cope with 是「应对/处理」、B）consisted of 义偏：consist of 是「由…组成」、D）extended to 义偏：extend to 是「延伸到/扩展至」，均可排除。
第 5 空正确答案 D）differs。But + 强调差异的语境。其余三项：A）suffers 义偏：suffer from 是「受…之苦」、B）benefits 义偏：benefit from 是「受益于」、C）develops 搭配不当：develop 一般不接 from 表此意，均可排除。
第 6 空正确答案 B）evidence。表语 inconclusive 指向「证据」。其余三项：A）acceptance 义偏：acceptance 是「接受」、C）cultivation 干扰：cultivation 蹭 plant 字面、D）creation 义偏：creation 是「创造」，均可排除。
第 7 空正确答案 C）argued。下文 claimed 同义复现。其余三项：A）doubted 方向反：doubt 是「怀疑」、B）denied 方向反：deny 是「否认」、D）requested 搭配/义偏：request 表「请求」，均可排除。
第 8 空正确答案 B）forming。前因后果：互动从而「构成」一个系统。其余三项：A）adapting 义偏：adapt 是「适应/改编」、C）repairing 义偏：repair 是「修复」、D）testing 义偏：test 是「测试」，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 A）analogous。全文主线是「植物与动物作类比」。其余三项：B）essential 义偏：essential to 是「对…必不可少」、C）suitable 义偏：suitable to/for 是「适合」、D）sensitive 义偏：sensitive to 是「对…敏感」，均可排除。
第 10 空正确答案 D）even。本句主张比上句更夸张，构成递进。其余三项：A）just 语气反：just 表「仅仅」，削弱、B）ever 用法偏：ever 多用于疑问/否定/比较、C）still 义偏：still 表「仍然」，无递进义，均可排除。
第 11 空正确答案 C）perspective。This 回指第3段那套「类比看法」。其余三项：A）restriction 义偏：restriction 是「限制」、B）experiment 义偏：前文是看法不是实验、D）demand 义偏：demand 是「要求/需求」，均可排除。
第 12 空正确答案 B）reducing。前句 simplify 同义提示。其余三项：A）attaching 义偏：attach to 是「把…附在…上」、C）returning 义偏：return to 是「返回/恢复」、D）exposing 义偏：expose to 是「使暴露于」，均可排除。
第 13 空正确答案 A）However。上句让步、本句转折拆穿。其余三项：B）Moreover 逻辑反：Moreover 表递进补充、C）Therefore 逻辑反：Therefore 表因果结论、D）Otherwise 逻辑反：Otherwise 表「否则」，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 C）superficially。only + 下文「不止是电活动」共指「表面」。其余三项：A）temporarily 义偏：temporarily 是「暂时地」、B）literally 义反：literally 是「确实/字面上」，强化、D）imaginarily 义偏：imaginarily 是「想象地」，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 B）level。of complexity and capacity 指向「程度」。其余三项：A）list 搭配不当：list of 是「清单」、C）label 义偏：label 是「标签」、D）load 义偏：load 是「负荷/装载量」，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 D）added。Taiz 在前文基础上再补一句。其余三项：A）recalled 义偏：recall 是「回忆」、B）agreed 义偏：agree 需有被附和的对象、C）questioned 语气反：question 是「质疑」，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 A）chances。Since 因果 + zero 指向「可能性」。其余三项：B）risks 色彩偏：risk 是「风险」含负面、C）excuses 义偏：excuse 是「借口」、D）assumptions 搭配不当：assumption 不与 zero 搭，均可排除。
第 18 空正确答案 A）danger。下文 threat、feel pain 同指「危险」。其余三项：B）failure 义偏：failure 是「失败」、C）warning 义偏：warning 是「警告」、D）control 义偏：control 是「控制」，均可排除。
第 19 空正确答案 D）recognizes。并列 can feel pain 提示「感知」。其余三项：A）represents 义偏：represent 是「代表/象征」、B）includes 义偏：include 是「包含」、C）reveals 义偏：reveal 是「揭示/显露」，均可排除。
第 20 空正确答案 B）poor。前文 can't run away → 该策略没用、糟糕。其余三项：A）humble 义偏：humble 是「谦逊/卑微」、C）practical 色彩反：practical 是「实用的」褒义、D）easy 义偏：easy 是「容易的」，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: The idea that plants have some degree of consciousness first took root in the early 2000s; the term "plant neurobiology" was [1] around the notion that some aspects of plant behavior could be [2] to intelligence in animals. [3] plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that [4] consciousness, researchers previously reported.
paragraphs.zh: 植物具有某种程度意识的观点最早萌芽于21世纪初;"植物神经生物学"这一术语是围绕植物行为的某些方面可与动物智能相比较这一概念而创造的。研究人员此前报告称,尽管植物缺乏大脑,但其茎和叶中电信号的发射仍然引发了暗示意识存在的反应。

paragraphs.en: But such an idea is untrue, according to a new opinion article. Plant biology is complex and fascinating, but it [5] so greatly from that of animals that so-called [6] of plants' intelligence is inconclusive, the authors wrote.
paragraphs.zh: 但根据一篇新的观点文章,这种观点是不正确的。作者写道,植物生物学是复杂而迷人的,但它与动物生物学差异如此之大,以至于所谓植物智能的证据是不确定的。

paragraphs.en: Beginning in 2006, some scientists have [7] that plants possess neuron-like cells that interact with hormones and neurotransmitters, [8] "a plant nervous system, [9] to that in animals," said lead study author Lincoln Taiz. "They [10] claimed that plants have 'brain-like command centers' at their root tips."
paragraphs.zh: 该研究的第一作者Lincoln Taiz说,从2006年开始,一些科学家认为植物拥有类似神经元的细胞,这些细胞与激素和神经递质相互作用,形成"类似于动物的植物神经系统"。"他们甚至声称植物在其根尖有'类似大脑的指挥中心'。"

paragraphs.en: This [11] makes sense if you simplify the workings of a complex brain, [12] it to an array of electrical pulses; cells in plants also communicate through electrical signals. [13] , the signaling in a plant is only [14] similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than "a mass of cells that communicate by electricity," Taiz said.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你简化复杂大脑的运作方式,将其简化为一系列电脉冲,这种观点就说得通;植物细胞也通过电信号进行交流。然而,Taiz说,植物中的信号传导只是在表面上类似于复杂动物大脑中的放电,而动物大脑不仅仅是"一团通过电流交流的细胞"。

paragraphs.en: "For consciousness to evolve, a brain with a threshold [15] of complexity and capacity is required," he [16] . "Since plants don't have nervous systems, the [17] that they have consciousness are effectively zero."
paragraphs.zh: 他补充说:"意识要进化,需要具有一定复杂性和容量阈值水平的大脑。由于植物没有神经系统,它们拥有意识的可能性实际上为零。"

paragraphs.en: And what's so great about consciousness, anyway? Plants can't run away from [18] , so investing energy in a body system which [19] a threat and can feel pain would be a very [20] evolutionary strategy, according to the article.
paragraphs.zh: 而且,意识究竟有什么了不起的呢?根据这篇文章,植物无法逃离危险,因此将能量投资于一个能识别威胁并能感受疼痛的身体系统,将是一个非常糟糕的进化策略。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown's 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas. Some rest in the shade of a parked car. Others drink water with the cows. This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate-friendly eggs. These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases. Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change. "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat. The birds' waste then fertilizes fields. Such improvements "allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers." The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering. In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart. More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories. If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond. Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine. Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein). The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability. Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment. Young adults "really care about the planet," says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations. "They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."

questions.stem: The climate-friendly eggs are produced____
options: A) at a considerably low cost.
B) at the demand of regular shoppers.
C) as a replacement for organic eggs.
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 D）on specially designed farms. 定位句在第 2 段：这些鸡蛋如今正以高达每打 8 美元的价格首次上架，它们仍贴着有机和善待动物的标签，但同时来自饲养在使用「再生农业」——一种通过特殊技术蓄养富含温室气体的土壤的农场里的鸡。正确项与原文构成同义替换（from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils ↔ on specially designed farms）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Larry Brown is excited about his progress in____
options: A) reducing the damage of worms.
B) accelerating the disposal of waste.
D) attracting customers to his products.
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 C）creating a sustainable system. 定位句在第 3 段：「我对我们取得的进展感到兴奋，」Brown 说道——他为总部位于丹佛的 Nest Fresh Eggs 收蛋，正在种更多吸引蠕虫和蟋蟀供鸡食用的覆盖作物。鸡的粪便再肥沃田地。这些改进「让我们的母鸡能觅食更高质量的天然饲料，这有益于土地、母鸡，以及我们供给客户的鸡蛋。」正确项与原文构成同义替换（cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat. The birds' waste then fertilizes fields ↔ creating a sustainable system；good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers ↔ sustainable）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The example of organic eggs is used in Paragraph 4 to suggest____
options: A) the doubts over natural feeds.
B) the setbacks in the egg industry.
C) the potential of regenerative products.
D) the promotional success of supermarkets.
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是例证目的题，正确答案 C）the potential of regenerative products. 定位句在第 4 段：蛋业的此次推动，是检验「再生农场动物产品能否成为下一类高端品」的首次重大试金石。短短十多年里，有机蛋从被视作天然食品店里的小众品发展到沃尔玛上架。最近益生菌和植物肉也曾遭遇类似怀疑，如今两者都已变成超市主要品类。如果可持续蛋的推广成功，将为再生牛肉、西兰花等打开闸门。正确项与原文构成同义替换（If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond ↔ the potential of regenerative products；regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond ↔ regenerative products）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the last paragraph that young people____
options: A) are reluctant to change their diet.
B) are likely to buy climate-friendly eggs.
C) are curious about new food.
D) are amazed at agriculture advances.
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是推断题，正确答案 B）are likely to buy climate-friendly eggs. 定位句在第 6 段：业界押注：那些已经为散养、非转基因、牧场放养等高端属性多付钱的消费者，也会拥抱可持续性。调查显示年轻一代更关注气候变化，植物肉的部分成功可归因于消费者想表达保护环境的意愿。Brunnquell 说，年轻人「真心关心地球」。正确项与原文构成同义替换（younger generations are more concerned about climate change ↔ are likely to buy climate-friendly eggs；the same consumers paying more for premium attributes...will embrace sustainability ↔ climate-friendly eggs）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: John Brunnquell would disagree with Julie Stanton over regenerative products'____
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是细节题，正确答案 A）market prospects. 定位句在第 5 段：宾州州立大学布兰迪万分校农业经济学副教授 Julie Stanton 说，再生类产品可能很难卖，因为「再生」这个概念很难一句话讲清楚。这种农法对食品本身的改善也微乎其微，甚至几乎没有（尽管有些生产者说他们的蛋蛋白质更多）。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Regenerative products could be a hard sell ↔ market prospects；The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes...will embrace sustainability ↔ market prospects）。其余三项中，B 项属答非所问、C 项属答非所问、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown's 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas. Some rest in the shade of a parked car. Others drink water with the cows. This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate-friendly eggs.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近一个阳光明媚的日子里,13000只鸡在德克萨斯州Shiner的Larry Brown那片40英亩的多风土地上漫步。一些鸡在停放的汽车阴影下休息。另一些则和奶牛一起喝水。这一切看似随意,但实际上是经过设计的,是这个价值61亿美元的美国鸡蛋产业押注的下一个大趋势的一部分:气候友好型鸡蛋。

paragraphs.en: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases. Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change.
paragraphs.zh: 这些鸡蛋目前正在货架上首次亮相,售价高达每打8美元,它们仍然标有有机和动物友好的标签,但它们也来自生活在使用再生农业的农场上的鸟类——这种特殊技术培育能够捕获温室气体的肥沃土壤。这类鸡蛋可以作为帮助对抗气候变化的产品进行营销。

paragraphs.en: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat. The birds' waste then fertilizes fields. Such improvements "allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers."
paragraphs.zh: "我对我们的进展感到兴奋,"为位于丹佛的Nest Fresh Eggs收获鸡蛋的Brown说,他正在增加更多覆盖作物,以吸引蚯蚓和蟋蟀供鸡食用。然后鸟类的粪便为田地施肥。这些改进"使我们的母鸡能够觅食更高质量的天然饲料,这对土地、母鸡以及我们供应给客户的鸡蛋都有好处。"

paragraphs.en: The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering. In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart. More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories. If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond.
paragraphs.zh: 鸡蛋行业的推动是对来自再生农场的动物产品能否成为下一个高端产品的首次重大考验。在短短十多年里,有机鸡蛋从被视为天然食品商店的小众产品发展到在沃尔玛销售。最近,益生菌和植物基肉类也曾遭遇类似质疑,但两者都已爆发式增长成为超市的主要品类。如果可持续鸡蛋的推出取得成功,它可能为再生牛肉、西兰花及更多产品打开闸门。

paragraphs.en: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine. Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein).
paragraphs.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学Brandywine分校农业经济学副教授Julie Stanton说,再生产品可能难以销售,因为这个概念很难快速定义。这种农业方式对食品本身的改善也极少,甚至没有(尽管一些生产商声称他们的鸡蛋含有更多蛋白质)。

paragraphs.en: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability. Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment. Young adults "really care about the planet," says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations. "They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."
paragraphs.zh: 该行业押注那些愿意为自由放养、非转基因和牧场饲养等优质属性支付更多费用的消费者将会接受可持续性。调查显示,年轻一代更关注气候变化,植物基肉类的部分成功可以归因于购物者希望表明他们保护环境的愿望。Egg Innovations总裁John Brunnquell说,年轻人"真的很关心地球","他们正在彻底改变食物链,其影响甚至超出了我认为他们自己所理解的程度。"

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: More Americans are opting to work well into retirement, a growing trend that threatens to upend the old workforce model. One in three Americans who are at least 40 have or plan to have a job in retirement to prepare for a longer life, according to a survey conducted by Harris Poll for TD Ameritrade. Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed. Financial needs aren't the only culprit for the "unretirement" trend. Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression. About 72% of "unretiree" respondents said that they would return to work once retired to keep mentally fit while 59% said it would be tied to making ends meet. "The concept of retirement is evolving," said Christine Russell, senior manager of retirement at TD Ameritrade. "It's not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement." One reason for the change in retirement patterns: Americans are living longer. The share of the population 65 and older was 16% in 2018, up 32% from the prior year, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That's also up 30.2% since 2010. Older Americans are also the fastest-growing segment of the US workforce, and boomers are expected to live longer than previous generations. The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades. About 20% of people 65 and older were in the workforce in February, up from an all-time low of 10% in January 1985, according to money manager United Income. Because of longer life spans, Americans are also boosting their savings to preserve their nest eggs, the TD Ameritrade study showed, which surveyed 2000 adults between 40 and 79. Six in 10 "unretirees" are increasing their savings in anticipation of a longer life, according to the survey. Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts. Unfortunately, many people who are opting to work in retirement are preparing to do so because they are worried about making ends meet in their later years, said Brent Weiss, a co-founder at Baltimore-based financial-planning firm Facet Wealth. He suggested that preretirees should speak with a financial adviser to set long-term financial goals. "The most challenging moments in life are getting married, starting a family and ultimately retiring," Weiss said. "It's not just a financial decision, but an emotional one. Many people believe they can't retire."

questions.stem: The survey conducted by Harris Poll indicates that____
options: A) over half of the retirees are physically fit for work.
B) the old workforce is as active as the younger one.
C) one in three Americans enjoy earlier retirement.
D) more Americans are willing to work in retirement.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是细节题，正确答案 D）more Americans are willing to work in retirement. 定位句在第 2 段：据 Harris Poll 为 TD Ameritrade 做的一项调查，40 岁以上美国人中每三人就有一人已有或计划在退休后工作，以应对更长寿命；更令人惊讶的是，超过半数的"unretirees"（即计划退休后继续工作或退休后又回到工作岗位者）表示，即便钱够了也仍愿在晚年继续就业。正确项与原文构成同义替换（One in three Americans who are at least 40 have or plan to have a job in retirement ↔ more Americans are willing to work in retirement；more than half of "unretirees"…said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down ↔ willing to work in retirement）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from Paragraph 3 that Americans tend to think that____
options: A) retirement may cause problems for them.
B) boredom can be relieved after retirement.
C) the mental health of retirees is overlooked.
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是推断题，正确答案 A）retirement may cause problems for them. 定位句在第 3 段：财务需要并非"unretirement"现象的唯一原因。据该研究，其他原因还包括获得个人成就感，比如保持心智健康、防止无聊或避免抑郁。正确项与原文构成同义替换（staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression ↔ retirement may cause problems for them）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: Retirement patterns are changing partly due to____
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是细节题，正确答案 C）longer life expectancy. 定位句在第 5 段：退休模式改变的一个原因：美国人活得更久。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Americans are living longer. ↔ longer life expectancy）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: Many "unretirees" are increasing their savings by____
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是细节题，正确答案 D）spending less. 定位句在第 6 段：据该公司称，他们这么做（增加储蓄）最常见的方式包括：削减总体开支、购买寿险或将退休账户缴款最大化。正确项与原文构成同义替换（reducing their overall expenses ↔ spending less）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: With regard to retirement, Brent Weiss thinks that many people are____
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是细节题，正确答案 A）unprepared. 定位句在第 7 段：Brent Weiss（巴尔的摩 Facet Wealth 理财公司联合创始人）说，遗憾的是，许多选择退休后继续工作的人之所以这样准备，是因为他们担心晚年入不敷出。他建议未退休者与理财顾问沟通以设定长期财务目标。正确项与原文构成同义替换（worried about making ends meet in their later years ↔ unprepared；preretirees should speak with a financial adviser to set long-term financial goals ↔ unprepared；Many people believe they can't retire. ↔ unprepared）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属过度推断、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.

Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression. About 72% of "unretiree" respondents said that they would return to work once retired to keep mentally fit while 59% said it would be tied to making ends meet.

The share of the population 65 and older was 16% in 2018, up 32% from the prior year, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That's also up 30.2% since 2010. The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades. Six in 10 "unretirees" are increasing their savings in anticipation of a longer life, according to the survey. Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts.
paragraphs.zh: TD Ameritrade的研究显示,由于寿命延长,美国人也在增加储蓄以保护他们的养老金,该研究调查了2000名年龄在40至79岁之间的成年人。根据调查,十分之六的"不退休者"正在增加储蓄以应对更长的寿命。该公司表示,他们这样做的最流行方式包括减少总体开支、购买人寿保险或最大化他们对退休账户的缴款。

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: We have all encountered them, in both our personal and professional lives. Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel. Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice. These are examples of dark patterns. First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, "dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users. Brignull identifies 12 types of common dark patterns, ranging from misdirection and hidden costs to "roach motel", where a user experience seems easy and intuitive at the start, but turns difficult when the user tries to get out. In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices. Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood. Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender. Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns? Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions. Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding "digital deception." Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level. In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out." As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community. Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.

questions.stem: It can be learned from the first two paragraphs that dark patterns____
options: B) leak user information for profit
D) remind users of hidden costs
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是细节题，正确答案 C）undermine users' decision-making 定位句在第 2 段：用户体验专家 Harry Brignull 于 2010 年首创了"黑暗模式"这一统称，用以指代那些操纵用户界面、影响用户决策能力的设计手法。正确项与原文构成同义替换（influence the decision-making ability of users ↔ undermine users' decision-making；manipulate user interfaces ↔ undermine users' decision-making）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The 2019 study on dark patterns is mentioned to show____
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是例证目的题，正确答案 D）their strong presence 定位句在第 3 段：在一项 2019 年涉及 5.3 万个产品页面和 1.1 万个网站的研究中，研究者发现大约十分之一采用了这类设计手法。尽管广泛流行，黑暗模式这一概念却仍未被充分理解。正确项与原文构成同义替换（widely prevalent ↔ their strong presence；about one in 10 employs these design practices ↔ their strong presence）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、C 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: To handle digital deception, businesses should____
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是细节题，正确答案 B）talk with relevant teams 定位句在第 4 段：商家应当与 IT、合规、风控和法务团队展开对话以审查隐私政策，并把负责公司用户界面的用户体验设计师与程序员，以及负责注册、结账、定价和促销的营销与广告团队都纳入讨论。正确项与原文构成同义替换（engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams ↔ talk with relevant teams）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The additional regulations under the CCPA are intended to____
options: A) guide users through opt-out processes
B) protect consumers from being tricked
C) grant companies data privacy rights
D) restrict access to problematic content
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是细节题，正确答案 B）protect consumers from being tricked 定位句在第 5 段：三月，加州总检察长宣布批准了《加州消费者隐私法案》（CCPA）下的新增条例，旨在"确保消费者在行使数据隐私权时不会被混淆或误导"。正确项与原文构成同义替换（ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled ↔ protect consumers from being tricked）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属张冠李戴、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to the last paragraph, a key to coping with dark patterns is ____
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是细节题，正确答案 B）businesses' self-discipline 定位句在第 6 段：黑暗模式也可以通过自我监管来解决，但前提是组织自我问责——不仅对法律要求，还要对行业最佳实践和标准负责。正确项与原文构成同义替换（organizations hold themselves accountable ↔ businesses' self-discipline；self-regulatory basis ↔ businesses' self-discipline）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属张冠李戴、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel. Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice. These are examples of dark patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在个人生活和职业生涯中都遇到过它们。想想那些让你感到被欺骗或沮丧的会员资格或订阅服务，它们注册过程无缝顺畅，但后来却很难取消。本应简单透明的事情却可能被有意或无意地复杂化，从而损害消费者的选择权。这些就是暗黑模式的例子。

paragraphs.en: First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, "dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users. Brignull identifies 12 types of common dark patterns, ranging from misdirection and hidden costs to "roach motel", where a user experience seems easy and intuitive at the start, but turns difficult when the user tries to get out.
paragraphs.zh: 2010年由用户体验专家Harry Brignull首次提出，"暗黑模式"是一个概括性术语，指操纵用户界面以影响用户决策能力的做法。Brignull识别出12种常见的暗黑模式类型，从误导和隐藏成本到"蟑螂旅馆"，即用户体验在开始时看起来简单直观，但当用户试图退出时却变得困难。

paragraphs.en: In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices. Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood. Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.
paragraphs.zh: 在2019年一项对53000个产品页面和11000个网站的研究中，研究人员发现约十分之一采用了这些设计做法。尽管广泛流行，暗黑模式的概念仍未被充分理解。企业和非营利组织领导者应该意识到暗黑模式，并努力避免它们所产生的灰色地带。

paragraphs.en: Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns? Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions. Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding "digital deception."
paragraphs.zh: 道德的、具有说服力的设计与暗黑模式之间的界限在哪里?企业应该与IT、合规、风险和法律团队展开对话，审查其隐私政策，并将负责公司用户界面的客户/用户体验设计师和编码人员，以及负责注册、结账篮、定价和促销的营销人员和广告商纳入讨论。这些团队中的任何一个或全部都可能在创造或避免"数字欺骗"中发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level. In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out."
paragraphs.zh: 立法者和监管机构正在缓慢开始解决暗黑模式周围的模糊性问题，最近主要在州一级。3月，加州总检察长宣布批准California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)下的附加法规，"确保消费者在寻求行使其数据隐私权时不会感到困惑或被误导。这些法规旨在禁止暗黑模式——这意味着禁止公司使用令人困惑的语言或不必要的步骤，例如强迫他们点击多个屏幕或听取他们不应该选择退出的理由。"

paragraphs.en: As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community. Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.
paragraphs.zh: 随着更多州考虑颁布额外的法规，商业界需要更大的问责制。暗黑模式也可以在自律的基础上得到解决，但前提是组织不仅要对法律要求负责，还要对行业最佳实践和标准负责。

reading.passage: Although ethics classes are common around the world, scientists are unsure if their lessons can actually change behavior; evidence either way is weak, relying on contrived laboratory tests or sometimes unreliable self-reports. But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects. The researchers investigated one class session's impact on eating meat. They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students' attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering. Half of the students in four large philosophy classes read an article on the ethics of factory-farmed meat, optionally watched an 11-minute video on the topic and joined a 50-minute discussion. The other half focused on charitable giving instead. Then, unknown to the students, the researchers studied their anonymized meal-card purchases for that semester—nearly 14,000 receipts for almost 500 students. Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books. But among student subjects who discussed meat ethics, meal purchases containing meat decreased from 52 to 45 percent—and this effect held steady for the study's duration of several weeks. Purchases from the other group remained at 52 percent. "That's actually a pretty large effect for a pretty small intervention," Schwitzgebel says. Psychologist Nina Strohminger at the University of Pennsylvania, who was not involved in the study, says she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable. And if real, she notes, it might be reversible by another nudge: "Easy come, easy go." Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence—classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common. Second, the video may have had an emotional impact. Least rousing, he thinks, was rational argument, although his co-authors say reason might play a bigger role. Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants' eating habits and students' video exposure. Meanwhile, Schwitzgebel—who had predicted no effect—will be eating his words.

questions.stem: Scientists generally believe that the effects of ethics classes are____
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 A）hard to determine. 定位句在第 1 段：尽管伦理课在世界各地都很普遍，科学家们却不确定这些课的内容能否真的改变行为；正反两方面的证据都很薄弱，要么依赖人为设计的实验室测试，要么依赖有时并不可靠的自我报告。正确项与原文构成同义替换（scientists are unsure if their lessons can actually change behavior ↔ hard to determine；evidence either way is weak ↔ hard to determine）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a reason for the researchers to study meat eating?

questions.stem: Eric Schwitzgebel's previous findings suggest that ethics professors____
options: A) are seldom critical of their students.
B) are less sociable than other professors.
C) are not sensitive to political issues.

questions.stem: Nina Strohminger thinks that the effect of the intervention is____

questions.stem: Eric Schwitzgebel suspects that the students' change in behavior____

D) is a sign of self-development.

paragraphs.zh: 如果你像如今大多数作家一样，正在做一份工作来支付账单，那么找时间写作并不容易。但这并非不可能。这需要决心和专注。请记住，大多数畅销书作家在开始写作时都在做其他事情来谋生。而如今，即使是相当知名的作家也常常不得不做其他工作来补充他们的写作收入。

paragraphs.en: As Harlan Coben has suggested, it's a [8] of priorities. To make writing a priority, you'll have to [9] some of your day-to-day activities and some things you really enjoy. Depending on your [10] and your lifestyle, that might mean spending less time watching television or listening to music, though some people can write [11] they listen to music. You might have to [12] the amount of exercise or sport you do. You'll have to make social media an [13] activity rather than a daily, time-consuming [14] . There'll probably have to be less socialising with your friends and less time with your family. It's a [15] learning curve and it won't always make you popular.
paragraphs.zh: 正如Harlan Coben所建议的，这是一个优先级的问题。要让写作成为优先事项，你就必须牺牲一些日常活动和一些你真正喜欢的事情。根据你的兴趣和生活方式，这可能意味着减少看电视或听音乐的时间，尽管有些人可以一边听音乐一边写作。你可能不得不减少锻炼或运动的时间。你必须把社交媒体变成偶尔进行的活动，而不是每天耗时的习惯。你可能不得不减少与朋友的社交活动以及与家人相处的时间。这是一条艰难的学习曲线，不会总是让你受欢迎。

paragraphs.en: There's just one thing you should try to keep at least some time for, [16] your writing—and that's reading. Any writer needs to read as much and as widely as they can; it's the one [17] supporter—something you can't do without.
paragraphs.zh: 除了写作之外，只有一件事你应该尝试至少保留一些时间，那就是阅读。任何作家都需要尽可能多、尽可能广泛地阅读；这是唯一不可或缺的支撑——是你不能缺少的东西。

paragraphs.en: Time is finite. The older you get, the [18] it seems to go. We need to use it as carefully and as [19] as we can, that means prioritising our activities so that we spend most time on the things we really want to do. If you're a writer, that means— [20] writing.
paragraphs.zh: 时间是有限的。你年龄越大，时间似乎过得越快。我们需要尽可能谨慎和高效地利用时间，这意味着要对我们的活动进行优先排序，以便把大部分时间花在我们真正想做的事情上。如果你是一位作家，这意味着——首先是写作。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: The weather in Texas may have cooled since the recent extreme heat, but the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting in Austin this month as officials debate how climate change is taught in Texas schools. Pat Hardy, who sympathises with the views of the energy sector, is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils. "There are as many scientists working against all the panic of global climate change as there are those who are pushing it," she claims. "Texas is an energy state and we need to recognise that. You need to remember where your bread is buttered." Most scientists and experts sharply dispute Hardy's views. Board members like her "casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion," says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education. Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools. A study last year by the National Center for Science Education, a non-profit group of scientists and teachers, looking at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes, gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher. Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere. Glenn Branch, the centre's deputy director, cautions that setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards. Even if a state is considered a high performer in its science standards, "that does not mean it will be taught", he says. Another issue is that while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages—such as earth and space sciences in high schools—it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry. It is also less prominent in many social studies courses. Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers. They include materials sponsored by energy industry associations.

questions.stem: In Paragraph 1, the weather in Texas is mentioned to
options: A) forecast a policy shift in Texas schools.
B) stress the consequences of climate change.
C) indicate the atmosphere at the board meeting.
D) draw the public's attention to energy shortages.
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是例证目的题，正确答案 C）indicate the atmosphere at the board meeting. 定位句在第 1 段：Texas 的天气在近期极端高温之后或许已经降温，但本月在 Austin 召开的州教育委员会会议上，「气温」却会很高——因为官员们将就气候变化如何在 Texas 学校中被教授一事展开辩论。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting ↔ indicate the atmosphere at the board meeting；officials debate how climate change is taught in Texas schools ↔ atmosphere at the board meeting）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属答非所问、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What does Quinn think of Hardy?
options: A) She exaggerates the existing panic.
B) She denies the value of scientific work.
C) She shows no concern for pre-teens.
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 B）She denies the value of scientific work. 定位句在第 3 段：大多数科学家和专家强烈反对 Hardy 的观点。Texas Freedom Network 高级传播策略师 Dan Quinn 说，像她这样的董事会成员「将学者和科学家的毕生工作随随便便地当作又一个被误导的观点而不予理睬」。正确项与原文构成同义替换（casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists ↔ denies the value of scientific work；as just another misguided opinion ↔ denies the value）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The study mentioned in Paragraph 5 shows that
options: A) climate education is insufficient at state public schools.
B) policymakers have little drive for science education.
C) Texas is reluctant to rewrite its science textbooks.
D) environmental teaching in some states lacks supervision.
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是细节题，正确答案 A）climate education is insufficient at state public schools. 定位句在第 5 段：去年由 National Center for Science Education（一个由科学家与教师组成的非营利组织）开展的一项研究——该研究考察全美各州公立学校如何在科学课上处理气候变化——只给将将一半的美国州打出了 B+ 或更高的等级。正确项与原文构成同义替换（gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher ↔ climate education is insufficient at state public schools；state public schools across the country ↔ state public schools；how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes ↔ climate education）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属过度推断、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Branch, state-level science standards in the US______
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是细节题，正确答案 C）have limited influence. 定位句在第 6 段：该中心的副主任 Glenn Branch 提醒说，在一个把决策权下放给地方学区的国家里，制定州一级的科学标准只是一个有限的参照指标。正确项与原文构成同义替换（only one limited benchmark ↔ have limited influence；in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards ↔ limited）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: It is implied in the last paragraph that climate change teaching in some schools______
options: A) agrees to major public demands.
C) may misrepresent the energy sector.
D) can be swayed by external forces.
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是推断题，正确答案 D）can be swayed by external forces. 定位句在第 8 段：Branch 指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教材反映了气候变化的科学共识，仍有一些非官方教育资料正被分发给老师，这些资料传递的是更具偏向性的观点。其中包括由能源行业协会赞助的材料。正确项与原文构成同义替换（unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers ↔ can be swayed by external forces；materials sponsored by energy industry associations ↔ external forces）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: The weather in Texas may have cooled since the recent extreme heat, but the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting in Austin this month as officials debate how climate change is taught in Texas schools.
paragraphs.zh: 自最近的极端高温以来，得克萨斯州的天气可能已经转凉，但本月在奥斯汀举行的州教育委员会会议上，随着官员们就得克萨斯州学校如何教授气候变化展开辩论，气氛将会十分热烈。

paragraphs.en: Pat Hardy, who sympathises with the views of the energy sector, is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils. "There are as many scientists working against all the panic of global climate change as there are those who are pushing it," she claims. "Texas is an energy state and we need to recognise that. You need to remember where your bread is buttered."
paragraphs.zh: 同情能源行业观点的Pat Hardy正在抵制对青春期前学生科学标准的拟议修改。她声称："反对全球气候变化恐慌的科学家与推动它的科学家一样多。得克萨斯州是一个能源州，我们需要认识到这一点。你需要记住你的面包是谁给抹的黄油。"

paragraphs.en: Most scientists and experts sharply dispute Hardy's views. Board members like her "casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion," says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数科学家和专家强烈反对Hardy的观点。得克萨斯自由网络（一个监督公共教育的非营利组织）的高级传播策略师Dan Quinn表示，像她这样的委员会成员"随意将学者和科学家的职业研究成果当作又一个误导性的意见而不予理会"。

paragraphs.en: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
paragraphs.zh: 这样的辩论反映了美国各地的激烈讨论，因为研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生加大了要求在学校更多关注气候变化事实教学的呼声。

paragraphs.en: A study last year by the National Center for Science Education, a non-profit group of scientists and teachers, looking at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes, gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher. Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 美国国家科学教育中心（一个由科学家和教师组成的非营利组织）去年的一项研究考察了全国各州公立学校在科学课上如何处理气候变化问题，只有不到一半的美国各州获得了B+或更高的成绩。表现最差的10个州中包括一些人口最多的州，其中得克萨斯州获得了最低等级（F），并且由于其教科书在其他地方广泛销售而具有不成比例的影响力。

paragraphs.en: Glenn Branch, the centre's deputy director, cautions that setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards. Even if a state is considered a high performer in its science standards, "that does not mean it will be taught", he says.
paragraphs.zh: 该中心副主任Glenn Branch提醒说，在一个将决策权下放给地方学校委员会的国家，制定州级科学标准只是一个有限的基准。他表示，即使一个州在其科学标准方面被认为是表现优异者，"这并不意味着它会被教授"。

paragraphs.en: Another issue is that while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages—such as earth and space sciences in high schools—it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry. It is also less prominent in many social studies courses.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个问题是，虽然气候变化在某些学科和某些年龄段——例如高中的地球与空间科学——中得到了很好的整合，但在面向年幼儿童的课程以及更广泛教授的学科（如生物学和化学）中却没有得到很好的体现。它在许多社会研究课程中也不那么突出。

paragraphs.en: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers. They include materials sponsored by energy industry associations.
paragraphs.zh: Branch指出，即使越来越多的官方指导方针和教科书反映了关于气候变化的科学共识，但传达更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料正在分发给教师。这些材料包括由能源行业协会赞助的材料。

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s. Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there's an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market. In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market. The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals. "We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing," said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast. Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, "employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live," Taylor said. However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of a local association of realtors. "A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short term," Castle said, "and so it's a cyclical effect." Short-term rentals themselves are not the crux of the issue, said Keren Hom, an expert on affordable housing policy. "I think individuals being able to rent out their second home is a good thing. If it's their vacation home anyway, and it's just empty, why can't you make money off it?" Hom said. Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations. "I think the question is, shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?" Hom said. At the end of 2018, Governor Charlie Baker of Massachusetts signed a bill to rein in those potential investor-buyers. The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy. Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city's Inspectional Services Department. Hom said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but "if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more."

questions.stem: Which of the following is true of New England?
options: A) Its housing supply is at a very low level.
B) Its communities are in need of funding.
C) Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly.
D) Its home prices are under strict control.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是细节题，正确答案 A）Its housing supply is at a very low level. 定位句在第 1 段：如今，由于房价创历史新高、库存处于历史低位，对此类监管的紧迫性进一步上升，尤其是那些担心开发商进场扫货、把大批房源翻新后投放短租市场牟利的人。正确项与原文构成同义替换（historically low inventory ↔ housing supply is at a very low level）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The bill mentioned in Paragraph 2 was intended to______
options: B) ensure the supply of cheap housing.
C) punish illegal dealings in housing.
D) allow a free short-term rental market.
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是细节题，正确答案 D）allow a free short-term rental market. 定位句在第 2 段：州议会最近投票否决了一项原本会使各镇制定限制短租之法规变为违法的议案。正确项与原文构成同义替换（made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals ↔ allow a free short-term rental market）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Compared with Castle, Taylor is more likely to support______
options: A) further investment in local tourism.
B) an increase in affordable housing.
C) strict management of real estate agents.
D) a favorable policy for short-term workers.
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是推断题，正确答案 B）an increase in affordable housing. 定位句在第 3 段："我们的租赁房屋供给已到危机水平，" 大海岸地区劳动力住房联盟执行主任 Nick Taylor 说。在新罕布什尔南部各镇缺乏足够可负担房屋的情况下，"雇主很难吸引到员工，工人也很难找到住处，" Taylor 说。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns ↔ an increase in affordable housing）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What does Hom emphasize in Paragraph 5?
options: A) The urgency to upgrade short-term rental facilities.
B) The efficient operation of the local housing market.
C) The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes.
D) The proper procedures for renting out spare houses.
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是细节题，正确答案 C）The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes. 定位句在第 5 段：然而，当开发商企图建造大规模短租设施（实质上的酒店）以绕开税收和监管时，问题就出现了。"我想问题是：开发商实际上在建酒店，却把它伪装成非酒店，他难道不该像酒店那样被对待、被征税、被监管吗？" Hom 说。正确项与原文构成同义替换（developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations ↔ The necessity to stop developers from evading taxes；shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel ↔ stop developers from evading taxes）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、D 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

questions.stem: Hom holds that imposing registration requirements is______
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是推断题，正确答案 D）an inadequate solution. 定位句在第 7 段：Hom 表示，类似的登记要求或许能让陷入困境的城镇受益，但 "如果我们真想改变住房市场，最关键的一件事是我们必须多建房。"正确项与原文构成同义替换（could benefit struggling cities and towns, but "if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more" ↔ an inadequate solution）。其余三项中，A 项属过度推断、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s. Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there's an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.
paragraphs.zh: 自Airbnb等网站在2010年代兴起以来,新英格兰各地的社区一直在尝试监管短期租赁。如今,随着房价创历史新高、房源库存处于历史低位,这种监管变得愈发迫切,尤其是在那些担心开发商会大量收购房产并在短期租赁市场上转手牟取暴利的人群中。

paragraphs.en: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market. The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
paragraphs.zh: 在新罕布什尔州,租赁空置率已降至1%以下,住房倡导者担心不受管控的短期租赁将给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。州议会近期否决了一项法案,该法案本会禁止城镇制定限制短期租赁的立法。

paragraphs.en: "We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing," said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast. Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, "employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live," Taylor said.
paragraphs.zh: 大Seacoast地区劳动力住房联盟执行董事Nick Taylor表示:"我们在租赁住房供应方面已处于危机水平。"他说,由于新罕布什尔州南部城镇没有足够的经济适用房,"雇主难以吸引员工,而工人也难以找到住处。"

paragraphs.en: However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of a local association of realtors. "A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short term," Castle said, "and so it's a cyclical effect."
paragraphs.zh: 然而,当地房地产经纪人协会首席执行官Ryan Castle指出,短期租赁也为游客提供了住宿。Castle说:"许多工人为旅游业提供服务,而旅游业正是靠那些短期入住的人来支撑的,因此这是一种循环效应。"

paragraphs.en: Short-term rentals themselves are not the crux of the issue, said Keren Hom, an expert on affordable housing policy. "I think individuals being able to rent out their second home is a good thing. If it's their vacation home anyway, and it's just empty, why can't you make money off it?" Hom said. Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations. "I think the question is, shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?" Hom said.
paragraphs.zh: 经济适用房政策专家Keren Hom表示,短期租赁本身并非问题的症结所在。Hom说:"我认为个人能够出租他们的第二套住房是一件好事。如果那本来就是他们的度假屋,而且只是空置着,为什么不能用它赚钱呢?"然而,当开发商试图创建大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和监管时,问题就出现了。Hom说:"我认为问题在于,一个实际上在建酒店但伪装成非酒店的开发商,难道不应该像酒店那样被对待、征税和监管吗?"

paragraphs.en: At the end of 2018, Governor Charlie Baker of Massachusetts signed a bill to rein in those potential investor-buyers. The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy. Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city's Inspectional Services Department.
paragraphs.zh: 2018年底,马萨诸塞州州长Charlie Baker签署了一项法案以遏制那些潜在的投资买家。该法案要求每位租赁房东向州政府注册,强制要求他们购买保险,并在新的州税基础上为地方税开辟了可能性。波士顿更进一步,要求出租者向该市检查服务部门注册。

paragraphs.en: Hom said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but "if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more."
paragraphs.zh: Hom表示,类似的注册要求可能有利于陷入困境的城镇,但"如果我们想改变住房市场,最主要的是我们必须建造更多房屋。"

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: If you're heading for your nearest branch of Waterstones, the biggest book retailer in the UK, in search of the Duchess of Sussex's new children's book The Bench, you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit; the same may be true of The President's Daughter, the new thriller by Bill Clinton and James Patterson. Both of these books are published next week by Penguin Random House (PRH), a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones. The problem began late last year, when PRH confirmed that it had introduced a credit limit with Waterstones "at a very significant level". The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were "quietly retiring them to their relevant sections". PRH declined to comment on the issue, but a spokesperson for Waterstones told me: "Waterstones are currently operating with reduced credit terms from PRH, the only publisher in the UK to place any limitations on our ability to trade. We are not boycotting PRH titles but we are doing our utmost to ensure that availability for customers remains good despite the lower overall levels of stock. We are hopeful with our shops now open again that normality will return and that we will be allowed to buy appropriately. Certainly, our shops are exceptionally busy. The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018." In the meantime, PRH authors have been the losers. Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it's those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute. It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster—the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published. "This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power," says literary agent Andrew Lownie. "The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices. After all, many of the most interesting books in recent years have come from small publishers." We shall see whether that plurality is a casualty of the current need among publishers to be big enough to take on all-comers.

questions.stem: The author mentions two books in Paragraph 1 to present______
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是例证目的题，正确答案 A）an ongoing conflict. 定位句在第 1 段：这两本书都将由企鹅兰登（PRH）在下周出版，而该公司目前正与 Waterstones 处于僵持状态。正确项与原文构成同义替换（a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones ↔ an ongoing conflict）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018 ↔ Their customers remain loyal）。其余三项中，B 项属过度推断、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: Scientific papers are the recordkeepers of progress in research. Each year researchers publish millions of papers in more than 30,000 journals. The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates. The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers. Citation cartels, where journals, authors, and institutions conspire to inflate citation numbers, have existed for a long time. In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications. Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles. The advent of electronic publishing and authors' need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals. The birth of predatory journals wasn't far behind. These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers. In some instances, there is absolutely no relationship between the content of the article and the citations. The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals. Such practices can lead an article to accrue more than 150 citations in the same year that it was published. How insidious is this type of citation manipulation? In one example, an individual—acting as author, editor, and consultant—was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities. The problem is rampant in Scopus, a citation database, which includes a high number of the new "international" journals. In fact, a listing in Scopus seems to be a criterion to be targeted in this type of citation manipulation. Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice. Red flags include a large number of citations to an article within the first year. And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, the careers of scientists can be determined by______
options: A) how many citations their works contain.
B) how many times their papers are cited.
C) the prestige of the people they work with.
D) the status they have in scientific circles.
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 B）how many times their papers are cited. 定位句在第 1 段：科学家的职业生涯和其所在机构的声誉，取决于他们所发表论文的数量和声望，但更取决于这些论文所吸引到的引用。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the citations attracted by these papers ↔ how many times their papers are cited）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The support service consultancies tend to______
options: A) recommend journals to their clients.
B) list citation patterns for their clients.
C) ask authors to include extra citations.
D) advise contributors to cite each other.
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是细节题，正确答案 C）ask authors to include extra citations. 定位句在第 2 段：最近，这种掠夺性行为又出现了一种新形式——所谓的 'support service 咨询机构'，它们为个人作者和期刊提供语言及其他编辑支持，有时会建议投稿人为自己的文章添加若干引用。正确项与原文构成同义替换（advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles ↔ ask authors to include extra citations）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属张冠李戴、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The function of the "milk cow" journals is to______
options: A) boost citation counts for certain authors.
B) help scholars publish articles at low cost.
C) instruct first-time contributors in citation.
D) increase the readership of new journals.
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是细节题，正确答案 A）boost citation counts for certain authors. 定位句在第 3 段：这些期刊可以充当 '奶牛'：一期里每一篇文章都可能引用某一篇特定的论文或一组论文。在某些情形下，文章的内容与所添加的引用之间毫无关系。正确项与原文构成同义替换（every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers ↔ boost citation counts for certain authors；Such practices can lead an article to accrue more than 150 citations in the same year that it was published ↔ boost citation counts for certain authors）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What can be learned about Scopus from the last two paragraphs?
options: A) It fosters competition among citation providers.
B) It has the capability to identify suspicious citations.
C) It hinders the growth of "international" journals.
D) It is established to prevent citation manipulation.
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是细节题，正确答案 B）It has the capability to identify suspicious citations. 定位句在第 5 段：Scopus 自己就拥有检测这一不端行为所需的全部数据。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice ↔ It has the capability to identify suspicious citations；Red flags include a large number of citations to an article within the first year ↔ It has the capability to identify suspicious citations）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: What should an author do to deal with citation manipulators?
questions.explanation: 第 40 题是细节题，正确答案 D）Reveal their misconduct. 定位句在第 5 段：对于希望远离引用卡特尔活动的作者来说：当编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求你添加不当引用时，不要照办，并要把该请求上报给所投期刊。正确项与原文构成同义替换（do report the request to the journal ↔ Reveal their misconduct）。其余三项中，A 项属过度推断、B 项属无中生有、C 项属答非所问，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Scientific papers are the recordkeepers of progress in research. Each year researchers publish millions of papers in more than 30,000 journals. The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates. The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.
paragraphs.zh: 科学论文是研究进展的记录者。每年研究人员在超过30,000种期刊上发表数百万篇论文。科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量,包括期刊的感知质量(通过刊物的影响因子反映)以及特定论文累积的引用次数。科学家的职业生涯和其所在机构的声誉取决于他们发表论文的数量和声望,但更重要的是这些论文所吸引的引用次数。

paragraphs.en: Citation cartels, where journals, authors, and institutions conspire to inflate citation numbers, have existed for a long time. In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications. Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles.
paragraphs.zh: 引用卡特尔——期刊、作者和机构合谋夸大引用数字——已经存在很长时间了。2016年,研究人员开发了一种算法来识别可疑的引用模式,包括不成比例地相互引用的作者群体,以及频繁相互引用以提高其出版物影响因子的期刊群体。最近,这种掠夺性行为出现了另一种表现形式:所谓的支持服务咨询机构为个别作者和期刊提供语言和其他编辑支持,有时会建议投稿者在其文章中添加若干引用。

paragraphs.en: The advent of electronic publishing and authors' need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals. The birth of predatory journals wasn't far behind. These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers. In some instances, there is absolutely no relationship between the content of the article and the citations. The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals. Such practices can lead an article to accrue more than 150 citations in the same year that it was published.
paragraphs.zh: 电子出版的出现以及作者寻找论文发表渠道的需求催生了成千上万种新期刊。掠夺性期刊的诞生紧随其后。这些期刊可以充当摇钱树,一期中的每一篇文章都可能引用某篇特定论文或一系列论文。在某些情况下,文章内容与引用之间完全没有关系。奇特的是,编辑理应为之工作的期刊本身根本没有获利——它只是在为其他期刊提供引用。这种做法可以使一篇文章在发表当年就累积超过150次引用。

paragraphs.en: How insidious is this type of citation manipulation? In one example, an individual—acting as author, editor, and consultant—was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities. The problem is rampant in Scopus, a citation database, which includes a high number of the new "international" journals. In fact, a listing in Scopus seems to be a criterion to be targeted in this type of citation manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 这种引用操纵有多阴险?在一个例子中,一个人——同时充当作者、编辑和咨询顾问——能够利用至少15种期刊作为引用提供者,为三所大学五位科学家发表的文章提供引用。这个问题在Scopus这一引文数据库中非常猖獗,该数据库包含大量新的"国际"期刊。事实上,被Scopus收录似乎成为被这类引用操纵瞄准的一个标准。

paragraphs.en: Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice. Red flags include a large number of citations to an article within the first year. And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.
paragraphs.zh: Scopus本身拥有检测这种不当行为所需的全部数据。危险信号包括一篇文章在第一年内获得大量引用。对于希望远离引用卡特尔活动的作者:当编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求你添加不恰当的参考文献时,不要照做,并向期刊报告这一请求。

blanks.explanation: 第 1 空正确答案 C）located。线索是后接的方位短语 outside the walls。其余三项：A）displayed 义为"展示",与"位于城墙外"不搭、B）occupied 义为"占据",后接地点不通且语义生硬、D）equipped 义为"配备",答非所问，均可排除。
第 2 空正确答案 A）privately。线索是并列项 local governments(政府=公共出资)。其余三项：B）regularly 义为"定期地",讲频率而非来源、C）respectively 义为"分别地",需有多对一一对应才用、D）permanently 义为"永久地",与"资助来源"无关，均可排除。
第 3 空正确答案 D）combination。线索是 of … "karvan"… and "saray"(两个词相加)。其余三项：A）definition 义为"定义",一个词不是两词的"定义"、B）transition 义为"过渡/转变",与"两词合成"无关、C）substitution 义为"替换",方向相反，均可排除。
第 4 空正确答案 C）describe。线索是主语"The term caravan"(一个称谓词)。其余三项：A）classify 义为"分类",一个词不会"给人分类"、B）record 义为"记录",术语本身不"记录"人、D）connect 义为"连接",词不"连接"人，均可排除。
第 5 空正确答案 C）such as。线索是 groups of people 与其后三类人的"总—分"关系。其余三项：A）apart from 义为"除…之外",把例子排除在外,逻辑反、B）instead of 义为"而非",表替代,不合举例、D）along with 义为"连同",表伴随并列而非举例，均可排除。
第 6 空正确答案 A）construction。线索是 routes became more developed → increased。其余三项：B）restoration 义为"修复",针对旧物,与新增不符、C）impression 义为"印象",与"数量增加"无关、D）evaluation 义为"评估",答非所问，均可排除。
第 7 空正确答案 B）faced。线索是宾语 the possibility of being attacked… extreme weather(纯负面风险)。其余三项：A）doubted 义为"怀疑",风险真实存在,不该被怀疑、C）accepted 义为"接受",态度色彩与下文应对措施冲突、D）reduced 义为"减少",旅人本身并未减少风险，均可排除。

第 8 空正确答案 B）subjected。线索是 being ___ to extreme weather 与前文 being attacked 并列(均为风险)。其余三项：A）assigned be assigned to=被分配到,语义不符、C）accustomed be accustomed to=习惯于,色彩相反、D）opposed be opposed to=反对,主谓逻辑不通，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 A）so that。线索是 strategically placed(有意为之)与"一天可达"的目的关系。其余三项：B）even if 义为"即使",表让步,无转折语境、C）now that 义为"既然",表已知原因,因果方向反、D）in case 义为"以防",表预防的偶发情况,不合，均可排除。
第 10 空正确答案 D）meeting。线索是 for the various people who travelled(各路人)。其余三项：A）talking talking point="热议话题",非"地点"、B）starting starting point=起点,只对单向起程,偏窄、C）breaking breaking point="崩溃点/极限",语义全反，均可排除。
第 11 空正确答案 D）As a result。线索是上句"会合点"→本句"成为文化交流中心"的因果。其余三项：A）By the way 义为"顺便说",引出离题补充,不合、B）On occasion 义为"偶尔",与"成为重要中心"的常态冲突、C）In comparison 义为"相比之下",无对比对象，均可排除。
第 12 空正确答案 C）exchange。线索是 with travellers sharing their cultures, ideas and beliefs(互相分享)。其余三项：A）heritage 义为"遗产",静态,不含"互相"义、B）revival 义为"复兴",讲重新兴起,非交流、D）status 义为"地位",与"交流互动"无关，均可排除。
第 13 空正确答案 C）as well as。线索是"sharing(分享出去)"与"taking knowledge(带走)"两动作同向并列。其余三项：A）with regard to 义为"关于",引出话题,不连接动作、B）in spite of 义为"尽管",但两动作无对立,无让步、D）in line with 义为"与…一致",表符合,非并列，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 B）influencing。线索是上文"文化交流"对"文明发展"的推动。其余三项：A）completing 义为"完成",文明发展非被"完成"、C）resuming 义为"重启/恢复",无"中断后再启"语境、D）pioneering 义为"开创",程度过头且不搭 development，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 A）aided。线索是 an important marketplace(重要市场,正面促进)。其余三项：B）invested invest in 主语应是投资者,搭配主体不符、C）failed 义为"失败",负面,与"重要市场"色彩冲突、D）competed compete in=参与竞争,驿站非贸易竞争方，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 B）Indeed。线索是上句"重要市场"与本句"常是商人第一站"的同向强化。其余三项：A）Rather 义为"相反/而是",需先否定再纠正,无此语境、C）Otherwise 义为"否则",表反向假设,不合、D）However 义为"然而",表转折,但前后无对立，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 D）stock up on。线索是 supplies for their own journeys(为自己旅途备的物资)。其余三项：A）go in for 义为"爱好/参加",不与 supplies 搭、B）stand up for 义为"维护/支持",对象应是人或主张、C）close in on 义为"逼近/包围",方向语义全不符，均可排除。
第 18 空正确答案 A）believed。线索是"around 12,000 to 15,000…were built"(对过去数量的估算)。其余三项：B）predicted 义为"预测",指向未来,与 were built 时态冲突、C）recalled 义为"回忆",需亲历者,不合泛指估计、D）implied 义为"暗示",与直接给出数字不符，均可排除。
第 19 空正确答案 D）although。线索是"建过 12,000-15,000"与"今仅存约 3,000"的数量反差。其余三项：A）until 义为"直到",表时间终点,无时间延续关系、B）because 义为"因为",二者非因果、C）unless 义为"除非",表条件,不合陈述事实，均可排除。
第 20 空正确答案 A）ruins。线索是 only about 3,000 remain(幸存的古老建筑)。其余三项：B）debt in debt=负债,主体应是人/机构、C）fashion in fashion=流行,与"破败古迹"色彩相反、D）series in series=串联,术语义,不合语境，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Caravanserais were roadside inns that were built along the Silk Road in areas including China, North Africa and the Middle East. They were typically [1] outside the walls of a city or village and were usually funded by local governments or [2] .
paragraphs.zh: 商队旅馆是沿丝绸之路修建的路边客栈,分布在包括中国、北非和中东在内的地区。它们通常位于城市或村庄的城墙外,通常由地方政府或私人资助。

paragraphs.en: The word "caravanserai" is a [3] of the Persian words "karvan", which means a group of travellers or a caravan, and "saray", a palace or enclosed building. The term caravan was used to [4] groups of people who travelled together across the ancient network for safety reasons, [5] merchants, travellers or pilgrims.
paragraphs.zh: caravanserai这个词由波斯语karvan和saray组合而成,karvan意为一群旅行者或商队,saray意为宫殿或封闭建筑。商队一词用来描述出于安全原因而结伴穿越古代贸易网络的群体,如商人、旅行者或朝圣者。

paragraphs.en: From the 10th century onwards, as merchant and travel routes became more developed, the [6] of caravanserais increased and they served as a safe place for people to rest at night. Travellers on the Silk Road [7] the possibility of being attacked by thieves or being [8] to extreme weather conditions. For this reason, caravanserais were strategically placed [9] they could be reached in a day's travel time.
paragraphs.zh: 从10世纪开始,随着商贸和旅行路线的日益发达,商队旅馆的建设有所增加,它们成为人们夜间休息的安全场所。丝绸之路上的旅行者面临着被盗贼袭击或遭遇极端天气条件的可能性。因此,商队旅馆被战略性地设置,以便人们能在一天的行程内到达。

paragraphs.en: Caravanserais served as an informal [10] point for the various people who travelled the Silk Road. [11] , these structures became important centres for cultural [12] and interaction, with travellers sharing their cultures, ideas and beliefs, [13] taking knowledge with them, greatly [14] the development of several civilisations.
paragraphs.zh: 商队旅馆成为往来丝绸之路的各类人群的非正式聚集点。因此,这些建筑成为文化交流和互动的重要中心,旅行者分享他们的文化、思想和信仰,同时也带走知识,极大地影响了多个文明的发展。

paragraphs.en: Caravanserais were also an important marketplace for commodities and [15] in the trade of goods along the Silk Road. [16] , it was frequently the first stop for merchants looking to sell their wares and [17] supplies for their own journeys. It is [18] that around 12,000 to 15,000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, [19] only about 3,000 are known to remain today, many of which are in [20] .
paragraphs.zh: 商队旅馆也是商品的重要交易场所,促进了丝绸之路沿线的货物贸易。事实上,它经常是商人出售货物和为自己的旅程储备补给的第一站。据信沿丝绸之路修建了约12000至15000座商队旅馆,尽管目前已知仅存约3000座,其中许多已成废墟。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: In the quest for the perfect lawn, homeowners across the country are taking a shortcut—and it is the environment that is paying the price. About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles. The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass from this year's event, declaring it to be not part of its ethos. The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity. Ed Home, of the RHS, said: "We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic. We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment." The RHS's decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes. A Twitter account, which claims to "cut through the greenwash" of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers. It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an "ecological damage" tax on such lawns. They have gathered 7,276 and 11,282 signatures. However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol. The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more. The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects. In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has "no plans to ban the use of artificial grass". It added: "We prefer to help people and organisations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters. However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage, while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives."

questions.stem: The RHS thinks that plastic grass_____.
options: A) is harmful to the environment
B) is a hot topic in gardening circles
C) is overpraised in the annual show
D) is ruining the view of west London
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 A）is harmful to the environment 定位句在第 1 段：皇家园艺学会（RHS）——西伦敦那场年度花展的主办方——称之所以引入这一禁令，是因为人造草坪会对环境和生物多样性造成损害。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity ↔ is harmful to the environment）。其余三项中，B 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: The petitions mentioned in Paragraph 3 reveal the campaigners'_____.
options: B) resistance to fake grass use
C) anger over the proposed tax
D) concern about real grass supply
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 B）resistance to fake grass use 定位句在第 3 段：它正在尝试鼓励人们签署两份请愿书，一份呼吁禁售人造草坪，另一份呼吁对这种草坪征收"生态破坏"税。正确项与原文构成同义替换（one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an "ecological damage" tax on such lawns ↔ resistance to fake grass use）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: In Paragraph 4, supporters of fake grass point out_____.
options: A) the necessity to lower the costs of fake grass
B) the disadvantages of growing real grass
C) the way to take care of artificial lawns
D) the challenges of insect habitat protection
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是细节题，正确答案 B）the disadvantages of growing real grass 定位句在第 4 段：然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也有环境代价——它需要修剪，因而通常要耗电或耗汽油。行业也指出，真草需要大量水、除草剂或其他处理，而铺设人造草坪的人往往会更多地使用自家花园。正确项与原文构成同义替换（natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol ↔ the disadvantages of growing real grass；real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments ↔ growing real grass）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属答非所问、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What would the government do with regard to artificial grass?
options: A) Urge legislation to restrict its use.
B) Take measures to guarantee its quality.
C) Remind its users to obey existing rules.
D) Replace it with sustainable alternatives.
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是细节题，正确答案 C）Remind its users to obey existing rules. 定位句在第 6 段：我们更愿意帮助公众和组织做出正确选择，而不是就此类事项立法。但是，使用人造草坪必须遵守现行的、用以保护生物多样性与确保可持续排水的法律与政策保障；同时，诸如强化的生物多样性义务等措施应当推动公共部门考虑可持续的替代方案。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage ↔ Remind its users to obey existing rules.；prefer to help people and organisations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters ↔ Remind its users）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the text that fake grass_____.
options: B) has seen a market share decline
D) has been a controversial product
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是主旨题，正确答案 D）has been a controversial product 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity ↔ has been a controversial product；However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns ↔ controversial；no plans to ban the use of artificial grass ↔ has been）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more.
